Scenery Series No. 1
cz:
Carlovo klidne Hyrule
Serie krajin c. 1

en:
Carlov's Peaceful Hyrule
Scenery Series No. 2
cz:
Carlovo klidne Hyrule
Serie krajin c. 2

en:
Carlov's Peaceful Hyrule
Scenery Series No. 3
cz:
Carlovo klidne Hyrule
Serie krajin c. 3

en:
With a boisterous crow and a cute
crest, these feathered friends
are the most popular pets in Hyrule.
The baby chicks like small bugs.
cz:
Se svym hlasitym krakoranim a
roztomilym hrebinkem jsou tito
opereni kamosi nejoblibenejsi
mazlicci v Hyrule. Kurata maji
rada drobny hmyz.

en:
This small ranch lies just outside
Hyrule Town. Father-and-daughter
team Talon and Malon run it, and they
sell the finest milk in Hyrule!
cz:
Tato mala farma lezi kousek za
mestem Hyrule. Vedou ji otec
s dcerou, Talon a Malon, a
prodavaji nejlepsi mleko v Hyrule!

en:
The people who built the Wind Ruins.
They now live above the clouds,
suspended by their own magic ability
to control the wind.
cz:
Lide, kteri postavili Vetrne
ruiny. Ted' ziji nad mraky,
drzeni svou magickou schopnosti
ovladat vitr.

en:
An old man plagued by an evil spirit.
Coming to his aid will bring you benefit
in the end, so if you meet him, you must
find a way to help him.
cz:
Starik suzovany zlym duchem.
Pomoc mu se ti nakonec vyplati,
takze az ho potkas, musis najit
zpusob, jak mu pomoct.

en:
Tingle (in green) and his twin younger
brothers Ankle (in purple) and Knuckle
(in blue). They believe fusing Kinstones
will help them meet fairies, so they are
recording Kinstone data on their maps.
David Jr. is not technically a relative.
cz:
Tingle (v zelenem) a jeho dvojcata,
mladsi bratri Ankle (fialovy) a
Knuckle (modry). Veri, ze spojovanim
Kamenu osudu potkaji vily, tak si
delaji zaznamy na mapach.
David Jr. neni technicky pribuzny.

en:
The Hyrulean vegetables grown in their
fields are exquisitely delicious.
Apparently, Brocco sells the best
of their crops.
cz:
Hyrulska zelenina z jejich poli
je vytecne chutna.
Brocco pry prodava to nejlepsi
z jejich urody.

en:
This Goron appears when you
successfully fuse certain Kinstone
pieces. He will sell you expensive,
but rare, Kinstone pieces.
cz:
Tento Goron se objevi, kdyz
uspesne spojis urcite kousky
Kamene osudu. Prodava drahe,
ale vzacne kousky Kamene osudu.

en:
Ghosts from the Royal Valley. The one
in the blue cap is Spookter, and the
one in the red cap is Spekter. Spookter
tries to be scary, but he's just not.
cz:
Duchove z Kralovskeho udoli.
Ten v modre cepici je Spookter,
v cervene Spekter. Spookter chce
byt strasidelny, ale neni.

en:
Appears in Minish dungeons.
They drop from the ceiling
unexpectedly. They are slow, so take
your time, and defeat them one by one.
cz:
Objevuje se v Minish dungeonech.
Necekane padaji ze stropu.
Jsou pomali, tak nespichej
a porazej je jednoho po druhem.

en:
Appears in Minish roads {Symbol:0D} dungeons.
These monsters have sharp mandibles.
Hit them when they shoot these away.
Avoid their attacks to get in close.
cz:
Objevuje se na Minish cestach {Symbol:0D} dungeonech.
Maji ostra kusadla. Trefuj je,
kdyz je odstreluji. Vyhybej se
jejich utokum a jdi blizko.

en:
Appears in Minish roads.
They come out of the ground when they
sense prey. If you get swallowed, you'll
take damage and get all dirty!
Watch out, because when you're all
dirty, Pestos will come after you.
cz:
Objevuje se na Minish cestach.
Vylezaji ze zeme, kdyz citi
korist. Kdyz te spolknou, utrpis
zraneni a budes cely spinavy!
Pozor, kdyz jsi spinavy,
prijdou po tobe Pestove.

en:
Appears in dungeons.
Covered in hard, spiny shells.
Few attacks work on them. You have
to flip them over to hurt them.
cz:
Objevuje se v dungeonech.
Maji tvrde, ostnate krunyre.
Malo utoku na ne funguje. Musis
je prevratit, abys jim ublizil.

en:
Appears in Castor Wilds.
They move when you put an arrow in
their eye. No other attacks work.
You can always just let them pass...
cz:
Objevuje se v Castor Wilds.
Pohnou se, kdyz jim das sipku
do oka. Jine utoky nefunguji.
Muzes je taky nechat projit...

en:
Appears in caves, etc.
Normally stay underground. They'll pop
out and spit seeds at you, but if you
get to know 'em, they're not so bad.
cz:
Objevuje se v jeskynich atd.
Bezne zustavaji pod zemi.
Vyskoci a plivnou po tobe seminka,
ale az je poznas, nejsou tak zli.

en:
Appears in the Wind Ruins.
Built by the Minish for the Wind Tribe
long ago. They look like stone statues,
but if you get too close, they move!
cz:
Objevuje se ve Vetrnych ruinach.
Davno je postavili Minish pro
Kmen vetru. Vypadaji jako sochy,
ale kdyz se priblizis, pohnou se!

en:
Appears in various areas.
These bats live in dungeons and caves.
Their movement is unpredictable, so use
ranged weapons from a safe distance.
cz:
Objevuje se v ruznych oblastech.
Tito netopyri ziji v dungeonech
a jeskynich. Pohyb je nevyzpytatelny,
uzij zbrane na dalku z bezpeci.

en:
Appears in various areas.
This thieving fox preys upon travelers
and merchants. He may not be strong,
but he will attack very quickly,
so be careful.
cz:
Objevuje se v ruznych oblastech.
Tato liska zlodejka lovi
cestovatele a kupce. Neni silna,
ale utoci hrozne rychle,
tak pozor.

en:
Appears in the Royal Valley, etc. 
These dark beasties are attracted to
light, and if they attack you, they
may suck your life away!
cz:
Objevuje se v Kralovskem udoli atd.
Tyto temne obludy laka svetlo,
a kdyz na tebe zautoci, mohou
ti vysat zivot!

en:
Appears in the Palace of Winds.
These mummies keep coming at you when
you attack. It's better to fight from a
distance if you want to avoid damage.
cz:
Objevuje se v Palaci vetru.
Tyto mumie na tebe porad lezou,
kdyz utocis. Lepsi je bojovat
z dalky, aby ses vyhnul zraneni.

en:
Appears in dungeons.
His hard shell protects him from swords,
but once he rolls into a ball, you can
use the {Color:Red}Gust Jar {Color:White}to draw him in.
cz:
Objevuje se v dungeonech.
Tvrdy krunyr ho chrani pred meci,
ale kdyz se srolije, muzes ho
pritahnout {Color:Red}Vetrnou nadobou{Color:White}.

en:
Appears in dungeons.
They cling to walls and move quickly.
Normal attacks may not work, but the
{Color:Red}boomerang {Color:White}is pretty effective.
cz:
Objevuje se v dungeonech.
Drzi se sten a pohybuji se rychle.
Bezne utoky nemusi zabrat, ale
{Color:Red}bumerang {Color:White}je docela ucinny.

en:
Appears in Castor Wilds.
These armor-clad soldiers are tough.
Use your {Color:Red}shield{Color:White} and {Color:Blue}rolling{Color:White} skills to
find an opening in their defenses...
cz:
Objevuje se v Castor Wilds.
Tito obrneni vojaci jsou tuzi.
Pouzij {Color:Red}stit{Color:White} a {Color:Blue}kotouly{Color:White}, at najdes
mezeru v jejich obrane...

en:
Appears in the Palace of Winds.
These Dark Nut commanders are strong,
but if you relax and wait for your
opening, you can still defeat them.
cz:
Objevuje se v Palaci vetru.
Tito velitele Dark Nutu jsou silni,
ale kdyz se uvolnis a pockas na
prilezitost, muzes je porazit.

en:
Appears in dungeons.
They move quickly to chase you once
they spot you. Your shield will block
them, but keep on your toes!
cz:
Objevuje se v dungeonech.
Jakmile te zmerkuji, rychle te
honicky. Stit je zablokuje,
ale zustan ve strehu!

en:
Appears in Veil Falls.
These tough Chuchus wear rocks on
their heads. The rocks protect them
from damage, so you'll have to find
a way to knock the rocks off before
you'll be able to destroy them.
cz:
Objevuje se ve Veil Falls.
Tito otuzili Chuchuove nosi
kameny na hlave. Kameny je chrani
ped zranenim, takze musis najit
zpusob, jak jim kameny srazit,
nez je zvladnes znicit.

en:
Appears in various areas.
These guys move quickly and randomly.
Trap them in a corner and take them
out quickly.
cz:
Objevuje se v ruznych oblastech.
Pohybuji se rychle a nahodne.
Zazen je do rohu a rychle
je sejmi.

en:
Appears in the Royal Crypt.
They look like doors, but they're really
traps! If you get too close to one, it
will fall down on you!
cz:
Objevuje se v Kralovske krypte.
Vypadaji jako dvere, ale jsou to
pasti! Kdyz se priblizis, spadne
to na tebe!

en:
Appears on Mount Crenel, etc.
These strange beasts hover on
propeller-like leaves. You can pull
them out of the sky with your {Color:Red}Gust Jar{Color:White}.
cz:
Objevuje se na Mt. Crenel atd.
Tyto podivne obludy se vznaseji
na vrtulovych listech. Muzes je
stahnout {Color:Red}Vetrnou nadobou{Color:White}.

en:
Appears in various areas.
Their fronts are protected with metal
masks, but their backsides aren't! Pop
off that mask for an easy battle.
cz:
Objevuje se v ruznych oblastech.
Zepredu je chrani kovove masky,
ale zezadu ne! Serazni jim masku
a boj bude snadny.

en:
Appears in dungeons.
If these guys grab you, they'll send
you back to the start of the dungeon.
Dodge them as they fall, then attack.
cz:
Objevuje se v dungeonech.
Kdyz te chytnou, poslou te zpet
na zacatek dungeonu. Kdyz padaji,
uhni a pak zautoc.

en:
Appears in dungeons.
If these guys grab you, they'll send
you back to the start of the dungeon.
Watch out when he attacks with others.
cz:
Objevuje se v dungeonech.
Kdyz te chytnou, poslou te zpet
na zacatek dungeonu. Pozor,
kdyz utoci s dalsimi.

en:
Appears in the Eastern Hills, etc.
Five of them pop out at once. If you
smack each one as they pop out of the
ground, they're a piece of cake.
cz:
Objevuje se ve Vychodnich pahorcich atd.
Vyskoci jich pet naraz. Kdyz
kazdeho praskes hned, jak vylezl,
je to hracka.

en:
Appears in dungeons.
They often gather in groups in narrow
areas. Once activated, they go a little
crazy. Take them out with arrows.
cz:
Objevuje se v dungeonech.
Casto se hromadi ve skupinach
v uzkych mistech. Kdyz je aktivujes,
zblazni se. Sejmi je sipy.

en:
Appears in dungeons.
They float in the air and explode when
touched. Walk carefully, and you may
escape unhurt...
cz:
Objevuje se v dungeonech.
Vznaseji se ve vzduchu a pri
dotyku vybouchnou. Chod opatrne
a mozna vyvaznes bez zraneni...

en:
Appears in caves, dungeons, etc.
Don't let them grab you: they'll eat
your shield if they hold you long
enough. Swing your sword to escape.
cz:
Objevuje se v jeskynich a dungeonech.
Nenech se chytit: kdyz te drzi dost
dlouho, seznou ti stit. Mavej mecem,
abys jim utekl.

en:
Appears in caves, dungeons, etc.
This Rupee Like has a Rupee dangling
from its head stalk. This clever lure
attracts greedy and delicious heroes.
cz:
Objevuje se v jeskynich, dungeonech.
Tento Rupee Like ma rupii visici
z hlavy. Ta chytra vnadidlo laka
chtive a chutne hrdiny.

en:
Appears in various areas.
They'll come straight for you if they
spot you. Just swing your sword when
they charge at you.
cz:
Objevuje se v ruznych oblastech.
Kdyz te zmerkuji, leti primo
na tebe. Kdyz se zenou, jen
machni mecem.

en:
Appears on Mount Crenel, etc.
These huge boulders come crashing
down from cliff walls. They fall in a
random pattern, so watch your step!
cz:
Objevuje se na Mt. Crenel atd.
Obri balvany se riti dolu ze sten
utesu. Padaji nahodne,
tak dej pozor, kam slapnes!

en:
Appears in the Palace of Winds.
They're not fast, but that iron ball is
a bruiser! Try to hit them after they
swing the ball.
cz:
Objevuje se v Palaci vetru.
Nejsou rychli, ale ta zelezna
koule bere za srdce! Zkus je
trefit, kdyz s ni maci.

en:
Appears in various areas.
They hide under common rocks and
grass. Be careful, because they can
pop out when you least expect it!
cz:
Objevuje se v ruznych oblastech.
Skryvaji se pod bezne kameny
a travu. Pozor, mohou vyskocit,
kdyz to nejmene cekas!

en:
Appears in Minish Woods, etc.
They rush you on sight. They also
block head-on attacks with their
spears, so circle around to attack.
cz:
Objevuje se v Minish lese atd.
Hned na tebe vyrazi. Cely utok
zepredu blokuji kopimi, tak je
obejdi a zautoc z boku.

en:
Appears in various areas.
They fire arrows at you on sight.
Block these with your {Color:Red}shield {Color:White}and
then close in to attack.
cz:
Objevuje se v ruznych oblastech.
Hned po tobe strili sipy.
Zablokuj je {Color:Red}stitem {Color:White}a pak
se pribliz a zautoc.

en:
Appears in the sky.
They swim through clouds like fish
in water. Attack them in that brief
moment when they pop out!
cz:
Objevuje se na obloze.
Plavou mraky jako ryby ve vode.
Zautoc na ne v tom kratkem
okamziku, kdy vykouknou!

en:
Appears in Minish roads, dungeons,
etc. There are red and blue ones.
They may look small and weak, but
their hard shells make them formidable.
cz:
Objevuje se na Minish cestach,
v dungeonech atd. Jsou cervene
i modre. Vypadaji male a slabe,
ale tvrdy krunyr je dela nebezpecne.

en:
Appears in Minish roads, dungeons,
etc. There are red and blue ones.
The blue ones are stronger and
throw things down on your head.
cz:
Objevuje se na Minish cestach,
v dungeonech atd. Jsou cervene
i modre. Modre jsou silnejsi
a hazi po tobe veci shora.

en:
Appears in Deepwood Shrine.
These mushroom beasties scatter
spores all over dungeons. When their
caps are red, they are invincible.
cz:
Objevuje se v Deepwood Shrine.
Tyto houbove obludy rozhazuji
vyspory po celych dungeonech.
Kdyz maji cervene klobouky, jsou
neporazitelne.

en:
Appears in the Palace of Winds, etc.
They fire magic bolts from afar. Hit
them when they appear so they don't
cast another spell!
cz:
Objevuje se v Palaci vetru atd.
Strileji magicke blesky z dalky.
Trefuj je, jakmile se objevi,
aby nesesulali dalsi kouzlo!

en:
Appears in the Palace of Winds.
They wield fire magic. Hit them when
they appear so they don't cast
another spell!
cz:
Objevuje se v Palaci vetru.
Ovladaji ohnivou magii. Trefuj je,
jakmile se objevi, aby nesesulali
dalsi kouzlo!

en:
Appears in the Palace of Winds.
They wield ice magic. They're weak
against fire, so attack with fire for a
quick battle!
cz:
Objevuje se v Palaci vetru.
Ovladaji ledovou magii. Slabi
na ohen, tak jim to nandej
ohnem pro rychly konec!

en:
Appears in dungeons.
They float in midair. They won't hurt
you, but if you touch them, you won't
be able to use your sword for a while.
cz:
Objevuje se v dungeonech.
Vznaseji se ve vzduchu. Neublizi
ti, ale kdyz se jich dotknes,
chvili nepouzijes mec.

en:
Appears in various areas.
There are red and blue ones. They've
appeared in every Zelda game to date.
They spit rocks, so be careful!
cz:
Objevuje se v ruznych oblastech.
Jsou cervene i modre. Objevili se
v kazde Zelde. Plivou kameny,
tak pozor!

en:
Appears in... Well, we're not sure!
The legendary Golden Octorok. It can't
be confirmed, but they are said to
shoot chunks of pure gold...
cz:
Objevuje se... No, my nevime!
Legendarni Zlaty Octorok. Neni to
potvrzeno, ale rika se, ze strili
kusy ryzeho zlata...

en:
Appears in... Well, we're not sure!
The legendary Golden Tektite.
Its basic attack is the same,
but it has much more power.
cz:
Objevuje se... No, my nevime!
Legendarni Zlata Tektite.
Zakladni utok je stejny,
ale ma mnohem vetsi silu.

en:
Appears in... Well, we're not sure!
The legendary Golden Rope. It's much
more aggressive than the normal ones:
it will attack you on sight.
cz:
Objevuje se... No, my nevime!
Legendarni Zlaty Rope. Je mnohem
agresivnejsi nez ti normalni:
hned na tebe zautoci.

en:
Appears in various areas.
The black one is Crow. If you touch
Takkuri, he will steal Rupees from
you, so be careful!
cz:
Objevuje se v ruznych oblastech.
Ten cerny je Crow. Kdyz se dotknes
Takkuriho, ukradne ti rupie,
tak pozor!

en:
Appears in the sky.
They float on clouds. They don't move,
but they do throw lightning bolts.
Steal their clouds with the {Color:Red}Gust Jar{Color:White}.
cz:
Objevuje se na obloze.
Vznaseji se na mracich. Nehybaji
se, ale hazi blesky. Ukradni
jim mraky {Color:Red}Vetrnou nadobou{Color:White}.

en:
Appears in dungeons.
Blue ones jump, and red ones throw
bones. See what happens when you
remove their heads with the {Color:Red}Gust Jar{Color:White}.
cz:
Objevuje se v dungeonech.
Modri skacou, cerveni hazi kosti.
Mrkni, co se stane, kdyz jim
sundas hlavu {Color:Red}Vetrnou nadobou{Color:White}.

en:
Appears in various areas.
They appear under rocks and grass.
If they grab you, you won't be able to
move. Swing your sword to get away.
cz:
Objevuje se v ruznych oblastech.
Objevuji se pod kameny a travou.
Kdyz te chytnou, nemuzes se hybat.
Mavej mecem, at se osvobodis.

en:
Appears in various areas.
Chuchus come in many colors.
Each color is a little different, but
ranged weapons work well against all.
cz:
Objevuje se v ruznych oblastech.
Chuchuove jsou v ruznych barvach.
Kazda barva je trochu jina,
ale zbrane na dalku fachaji na vsechny.

en:
Appears on Mount Crenel, etc.
They move by jumping long distances.
Their movement can be unpredictable,
so attack them when they are still.
cz:
Objevuje se na Mt. Crenel atd.
Pohybuji se dlouhymi skoky.
Jejich pohyb je nevyzpytatelny,
tak utoc, kdyz stoji.

en:
Appears in various areas.
A trap with sharp blades. Some are
triggered by nearby intruders, while
others follow a set path.
cz:
Objevuje se v ruznych oblastech.
Past s ostrymi cepelemi. Nektere
spousti blizky vetrelec, jine
sleduji urcenou drahu.

en:
Appears in Wind Ruins, Veil Falls.
These baddies move freely underground
when attacking. You never know where
they will pop up, so keep your {Color:Red}shield{Color:White}
raised and at the ready!
cz:
Objevuje se ve Vetrnych ruinach,
Veil Falls. Tito darebove se pohybuji
volne pod zemi, kdyz utoci. Nikdy
nevis, kde vyskoci, drz {Color:Red}stit{Color:White}
vzhuru a v pohotovosti!

en:
Appears in Deepwood Shrine, etc.
This caterpillar moves in a zigzag
pattern. If you hit him on the nose, he
gets upset and starts running around.
cz:
Objevuje se v Deepwood Shrine atd.
Tato housenka se pohybuje
cik-cak. Kdyz ji das do nosu,
nastve se a zacne behat kolem.

en:
Appears in various areas.
These Chuchus project spikes from
their bodies at the first sign of
danger. Try a well-placed bomb.
cz:
Objevuje se v ruznych oblastech.
Tito Chuchuove pri prvnim naznaku
nebezpeci vystrkuji ze sebe bodce.
Zkus dobre umistenou bombu.

en:
Appears in the Temple of Droplets.
Frozen solid by the power of the Water
Element. He's been frozen so long that
his hunger is unbearable.
cz:
Objevuje se v Chramu kapek.
Zamrzly silou Vodniho elementu.
Je zamrzly tak dlouho, ze jeho
hlad je nesnesitelny.

en:
Appears in Palace of Winds.
Females are larger than males.
They fly around the Palace of Winds,
preying on adventurers.
cz:
Objevuje se v Palaci vetru.
Samice jsou vetsi nez samci.
Letaji kolem Palace vetru
a lovi dobrodruhy.

en:
This is a legendary Goron with a body
bigger than a mountain. This Goron is
so big, in fact, that no one has ever
seen all of it at once.
cz:
Legendarni Goron s telem vetsim
nez hora. Tento Goron je tak
velky, ze ho nikdo nikdy
nevidel celeho naraz.

en:
Appears in Deepwood Shrine.
A perfectly ordinary Chuchu. Though
not much of an enemy usually, they are
terrifying to anyone Minish-sized.
cz:
Objevuje se v Deepwood Shrine.
Uplne bezny Chuchu. Obvykle to
neni velky nepritel, ale pro
Minish velikost je desivy.

en:
Appears in the Cave of Flames.
A Gleerok with a hard, rocky shell found
in Mount Crenel. Hiding in lava, this
beast spews fire on everything it sees.
cz:
Objevuje se v Cave of Flames.
Gleerok s tvrdym kamennym krunyrem
z Mt. Crenel. Skryty v lave chrli
ohen na vse, co vidi.

en:
Appears in the Wind Ruins.
Constructed by the Wind Tribe to repel
intruders, this sturdy machine cannot
be destroyed by any external force.
cz:
Objevuje se ve Vetrnych ruinach.
Postaven Kmenem vetru na odrazeni
vetrelcu. Tento pevny stroj neni
znicitelny zadnou vnejsi silou.

en:
Appears in the Temple of Droplets.
An ordinary blue Chuchu. Fighting him
while Minish-sized is daunting, but just
try to avoid that electric attack.
cz:
Objevuje se v Chramu kapek.
Bezny modry Chuchu. Boj s nim ve
Minish velikosti je nahonak,
vyhni se elektrickemu utoku.

en:
These two became fast friends because
of Smith and the king of Hyrule. Zelda
wishes that the sometimes unreliable
{Player} were just a wee bit stronger.
cz:
Ti dva se rychle spratelili diky
Smithovi a krali Hyrule. Zelda by
chtela, aby {Player}, obcas trochu
nespolehlivy, byl kapku silnejsi.

en:
The Minish Ezlo, before he was cursed
by Vaati. He is a famous Minish sage.
Even among Minish inventors, he was
renowned for his amazing creations.
cz:
Minish Ezlo predtim, nez ho
Vaati proklel. Je to slavny
Minish mudrc. I mezi Minish
vynalezci proslul svymi vytvory.

en:
Appears in Dark Hyrule Castle.
This is the strongest Dark Nut, with a
good balance of attack and defense.
They will do anything to stop you.
cz:
Objevuje se v Temnem hradu Hyrule.
Nejsilnejsi Dark Nut s dobrou
rovnovahou utoku a obrany.
Udelaji vse, aby te zastavili.

en:
The sorcerer Vaati took this form
after draining the power of the light
force from Princess Zelda. The evil
beams from his eyes are devastating.
cz:
Carodej Vaati na sebe vzal tuto
podobu pote, co vysal silu svetla
z princezny Zeldy. Zle paprsky
z jeho oci jsou zniciva.

en:
Once Vaati's body has been shattered,
this dark form rises up, all that
remains of the evil sorcerer. Only the
sacred Four Sword can defeat him.
cz:
Kdyz je Vaatiho telo rozdrceno,
zvedne se tato temna podoba,
vse, co zbylo ze zleho carodeje.
Jen posvatny Ctyrmec ho porazi.

en:
This is the embodiment of purest evil,
the final form of the power-mad Vaati.
Its mind is consumed with a hunger for
destruction. Find its weakness.
cz:
Vteleni nejcistsiho zla, konecna
podoba Vaatiho posedleho moci.
Jeho mysl pohlcuje hlad po
zkaze. Najdi jeho slabinu.

en:
This strange red postbox has the
ability to fuse Kinstone pieces with
you. Some say there is really just a
person hiding inside it...
cz:
Tato podivna cervena postovni
schranka umi s tebou spojovat
kousky Kamene osudu. Nekteri rikaji,
ze uvnitr je schovany clovek...

en:
{Sound:00:91}Ew! What is that? Is that a
caterpillar? It's disgusting!
Hey, kid! I'll just let you
take care of this one!
cz:
{Sound:00:91}Fuj! Co to je? Nejaka housenka?
Je to hnusny!
Hej, kluku! Nechavam to na tobe,
vyres to sam!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}What are you doing, talking to me at a
time like this! You've got work to do!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Co delas, ze se mnou v tuhle chvili
kecas! Mas prece praci!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}My word! It has spikes, it jumps...
What can't it do!? Ah, such a bother!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}No teda! Ma bodce, skace...
Co neumi!? Ach, takova otrava!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}Ahhhh! Watch your feet!! Such an
inhospitable monster this is!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Aaaaa! Dej pozor na nohy!!
Jake nepritelske monstrum!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}This must be another guardian,
wouldn't you agree?
Hm... Knock him down, and he just gets
back up again!
{Player}! It's time to see if you
can knock him down for good!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}To musi byt dalsi strazce,
nesouhlasis?
Hm... Srazis ho a on zas vstane!

{Player}! Cas videt, jestli ho
zvladnes srazit nadobro!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}{Player}! If you need my help, you
know where to find me!
Just give me a shout, and I'll see
what I can do to lend a...er...beak.
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}{Player}! Kdyz me budes potrebovat,
vis, kde me najit!
Staci zavolat a uvidim, jak
mohu podat pomocny...ehm...zobak.

en:
{Sound:00:92}{Player}, I would imagine that you can
take this thing out with ease now.
Just remember everything I've
taught you!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}{Player}, urcite tuhle vec zvladnes
sejmout s prehledem.
Jen si pamatuj vsechno, co jsem
te naucil!

en:
{Sound:00:91}This weather's miserable! I think I'm
catching a cold...
Ah...ah...achoo!

Oh, don't worry about me, {Player}.
I'm sure I'll be just fine... Sniffle...
cz:
{Sound:00:91}To pocasi je hrozne! Asi budu
mit rymu...
Apci...apci...hepci!

Ach, nedelej si o me starosti,
{Player}. Urcite budu v pohode...

en:
{Sound:00:92}These sky-flying rays will be no match
for my {Color:Red}White Sword{Color:White}!
I mean your {Color:Red}White Sword{Color:White}, {Player}!!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Tito oblacni rejnoci se nevyrovnaji
memu {Color:Red}Bilemu meci{Color:White}!
Chci rict tvemu {Color:Red}Bilemu meci{Color:White}, {Player}!!

en:
{Sound:00:91}Maybe I forgot to mention it,
but I'm not so good with heights...
But this thing would be a piece of cake
on land, am I not right?
Well, no point worrying about that now!
cz:
{Sound:00:91}Mozna jsem to zapomnel rict,
ale vysky mi moc nedelaji...
Ale na zemi by tohle byla hracka,
vid?
Ted' na to uz nemuzeme myslet!

en:
{Sound:00:92}These Black Knights are
in {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}'s service!
Exercise caution, {Player}!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Tito Cerni rytiri jsou
ve sluzbach {Color:Green}Vaatiho{Color:White}!
Bud' opatrny, {Player}!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}If we don't stop {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White} here, {Color:Green}Princess
Zelda{Color:White}--and all of Hyrule--is done for!
We cannot allow that to happen,
{Player}!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Kdyz {Color:Green}Vaatiho{Color:White} tady nezastavime,
{Color:Green}princezna Zelda{Color:White} - i cele Hyrule -
je ztracena! To nesmime dopustit,
{Player}!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}So this is the true form
of the {Color:Blue}sorcerer {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}!
So dark... So powerful... So evil!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Tak tohle je prava podoba
{Color:Blue}carodeje {Color:Green}Vaatiho{Color:White}!
Tak temna... Tak mocna... Tak zla!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}{Player}, judging by the look in your
eyes, I'd say you've made up your mind!
Excellent! Perhaps now, we are ready
to face {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}{Player}, podle toho pohledu v ocich
vidim, ze mas jasno!
Vyborne! Mozna jsme ted' pripraveni
postavit se {Color:Green}Vaatimu{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:00:92}He's mad with power! He's nothing but
a swirling mass of raw chaos now!
He will consume everything and reduce
the world to darkness!
If we let him go now, he will engulf
the world in an eternal night!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Zblaznil se z moci! Je jen viricim
shlukem syroveho chaosu!
Pozre vsechno a ponori svet
do temnoty!
Kdyz ho ted' nechame jit, uvrhne
svet do vecne noci!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}What are you doing!? We've no
time for any of your nonsense!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Co to delas!? Nemame cas na
zadne tvoje hlouposti!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Waugh! What a hideous face!
...It's no good, {Player}.
We tried to settle this peacefully, but
some people can't be reasoned with...
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Wau! Ta oskliva vizazi!
...Nema to cenu, {Player}.
Snazili jsme se to vyresit v klidu,
ale s nekterymi se domluvit neda...

en:
{Sound:00:8D}{Player}, save your breath!
Fight now and talk later!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}{Player}, setri dech!
Ted' bojuj a mluv potom!

en:
{Sound:00:91}So this would be the {Color:Green}Deepwood
Shrine{Color:White} the Minish elder spoke of...
He...said something about there being
monsters inside, didn't he?
He-Hey now! No reason to be afraid or
anything... I'll be waiting right here.
No, wait! What am I saying!? I'm not
letting you leave me alone out here!
cz:
{Sound:00:91}Tak tohle by byl {Color:Green}Deepwood
Shrine{Color:White}, o kterem mluvil starsi Minish...
Rikal...neco o tom, ze uvnitr
jsou nestvury, ze?
He-Hej ted'! Neni duvod se bat...
Budu cekat prave tady.
Ne, pockej! Co to rikam!? Nenecham
te, abys me nechal samotneho!

en:
{Sound:00:91}Wow... It's hot in here! Come on!
Let's not stand around wasting time!
Find that {Color:Red}element{Color:White}, so we can
get out of here!
cz:
{Sound:00:91}Wau... Je tu horko! No tak!
Nestujme tu a neplytvejme casem!
Najdi ten {Color:Red}element{Color:White}, at se
odsud dostaneme!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Hm. To think the ruins were hidden
within this cliff the whole time!
Watch your step, {Player}. There
may be traps in here.
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Hm. Pomyslet, ze ruiny byly cely
cas schovane v tomto utesu!
Davej pozor, {Player}. Muzou
tu byt pasti.

en:
{Sound:00:8D}Who knew there'd be someplace like this
behind one of the town's fountains?!
Well, let's get moving and see if we can
find that item those Minish mentioned.
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Kdo by cekal takove misto
za jednou z mestskych fontan?!
Tak pohyb a zkusme najit ten
predmet, o kterem Minish mluvili.

en:
{Sound:00:91}Urk... Owowow!! I just smacked my
hip on something!
Well, not my hip... My...whatever it
is I have now... My brim? Whatever!
That old fool must just love sending
people on dangerous missions!
And how did that {Color:Green}Librari{Color:White} get into
the {Color:Green}Temple of Droplets{Color:White}, anyway?
I guess the answer lies up ahead.
Keep moving, boy!
cz:
{Sound:00:91}Urk... Aujaujau!! Ted' jsem se
tloukl do boku!
Ne, do boku ne... Do...cokoliv
ted' mam... Do okraje? At uz!
Ten stary blazen musi milovat
posilat lidi na nebezpecne mise!
A jak se {Color:Green}Librari{Color:White} vubec dostal
do {Color:Green}Chramu kapek{Color:White}?
Odpoved' asi lezi pred nami.
Pohyb, chlapce!

en:
{Sound:00:91}Brrr...chatter chatter...
I'm freezing in here...!!
If you don't find that {Color:Red}element {Color:White}quickly,
I'm going to turn into a hatsicle!!
{Sound:00:92}Hurry up, {Player}!
cz:
{Sound:00:91}Brrr...cvakot cvakot...
Mrznu tu...!!
Kdyz rychle nenajdes ten {Color:Red}element{Color:White},
zmenim se v cepicovou rampouch!!
{Sound:00:92}Pospes si, {Player}!

en:
{Sound:00:91}It may be the Royal Crypt, but graves
are creepy, no matter whose they are!
Where are we supposed to go to meet
this {Color:Green}King Gustaf{Color:White} anyway?
I'm not so sure I even want to anymore!
Can we just go somewhere less creepy?
cz:
{Sound:00:91}Mozna je to Kralovska krypta,
ale hroby jsou strasidelne, at' uz ci!
Kam se mame vlastne dostat, abychom
potkali {Color:Green}krale Gustafa{Color:White}?
Uz si nejsem jisty, jestli chci!
Nemuzeme jit nekam mene strasidelneho?

en:
{Sound:00:8D}What an irritation! We find our way to
the very tops of the clouds...
And now we have to go even higher
to find a floating palace?
I can't believe what a long way we've
come. And look how high we are!
Don't look down, {Player}! And watch
your step! It's a long fall from here!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Jake vzteklina! Dostali jsme se
az na vrcholky mraku...
A ted' musime jeste vyse, abychom
nasli plovouci palac?
Nechce se mi verit, jak daleko jsme
prisli. A jak jsme vysoko!
Nedivej se dolu, {Player}! A pozor,
kam slapes! Odsud je to daleko dolu!

en:
{Sound:00:91}How much farther do we have to go!?
This place goes on forever!
Ah, there's no point in complaining
about it. We must press onward!
After all, how much more could there
be? Come on, {Player}! Let's go!
cz:
{Sound:00:91}Jak daleko jeste musime jit!?
Tohle misto pokracuje donekonecna!
Ach, nema smysl si stezovat.
Musime pokracovat dal!
Kolik toho jeste muze byt?
Jdeme, {Player}! Vyrazime!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}Whoa...!

Is this really {Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White}? I can't
believe it! What's happened here?
{Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}'s magic has grown more
powerful than I'd imagined...
{Sound:00:92}But the {Color:Green}king{Color:White} and {Color:Green}Zelda{Color:White} are in danger,
{Player}! Let's go!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Ou...!

Je tohle opravdu {Color:Green}hrad Hyrule{Color:White}?
Nechce se mi verit! Co se tu stalo?
{Color:Green}Vaatiho{Color:White} magie vzrostla vic,
nez jsem si predstavoval...
{Sound:00:92}Ale {Color:Green}kral{Color:White} a {Color:Green}Zelda{Color:White} jsou v nebezpeci,
{Player}! Jdeme!

en:
{Sound:00:92}These raindrops are like boulders of
water to us, kid! Watch out!
If one of them hits us, it'll sting
something fierce!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Tyto kapky deste jsou pro nas
jako vodni balvany, kluku! Pozor!
Kdyz nas jedna trefi, bude to
peklo bolet!

en:
{Sound:00:91}Hehehe! So, what do you think,
{Player}?
{01:0A}Pretty dark and spooky, isn't it?
Makes you wanna cry, doesn't it?
{01:01}What? You're...not scared?
Well, good! Neither am I!
{Sound:00:91}So, um... Come on, let's go...
cz:
{Sound:00:91}Hehehe! No, co ty na to,
{Player}?
{01:0A}Docela temne a strasidelne, co?
Chce se ti brecet, co?
{01:01}Coze? Ty...se nebojis?
Dobre, ja taky ne!
{Sound:00:91}Tak, ehm... No tak, jdeme...

en:
{Sound:00:92}Wow! Look at the size of that waterfall!
Beautiful! Simply beautiful, my boy!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Wau! Podivej, jaky to je vodopad!
Krasne! Proste krasne, chlapce!

en:
{Sound:00:92}A stone door!

So! This was what they meant by all of
that "{Color:Green}source of the flow{Color:White}" business!
Well, this waterfall certainly is the
source of all Hyrule's water.
According to {Color:Green}King Gustaf{Color:White}, the final
{Color:Red}element {Color:White}lies somewhere behind the falls.
We've dawdled long enough, {Player}!
Let's go find that element!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Kamenne dvere!

Tak! Tohle mysleli tim
"{Color:Green}zdrojem toku{Color:White}"!
Tento vodopad je urcite
zdrojem vsi vody Hyrule.
Podle {Color:Green}krale Gustafa{Color:White} lezi posledni
{Color:Red}element {Color:White}nekde za vodopadem.
Dlouho jsme se poflakovali, {Player}!
Pojd'me najit ten element!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}What have we here? Some kind
of vortex?
Well, we seem to have hit a dead end...
What shall we do from here?
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Copak to tu mame? Nejaky
vir?
Zda se, ze jsme narazili na slepou
ulicku... Co si pocneme?

en:
{01:0A}... ...

{01:01}Am I still alive?

{01:0A}... ...
... ...
{01:01}{Sound:00:8D}{Player}!!
What were you thinking, child!
You just reaped the whirlwind, as
they say! We could be dead right now!
{01:0A}... ...
... ...
...{01:01}But I must admit, it did the trick!{Sound:00:8E}
Are we...in the land above the clouds?
Then {Color:Blue}there must be something{Color:White} here that
can lead us to the final {Color:Red}element{Color:White}!
Let's go find it!
cz:
{01:0A}... ...

{01:01}Jsem stale nazivu?

{01:0A}... ...
... ...
{01:01}{Sound:00:8D}{Player}!!
Co sis myslel, dite!
Zasel jsi vichr, jak se rika!
Mohli jsme byt mrtvi!
{01:0A}... ...
... ...
...{01:01}Ale musim uznat, fungovalo to!{Sound:00:8E}
Jsme...v zemi nad mraky?
Pak tu {Color:Blue}musi byt neco{Color:White}, co nas
dovede k poslednimu {Color:Red}elementu{Color:White}!
Pojd'me to najit!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Now how do you build something
like this on top of a cloud?
Maybe someone lives inside. If so,
perhaps we could ask for the {Color:Red}element{Color:White}?
It's worth a shot, {Player}!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Jak muzes neco takoveho postavit
na mraku?
Mozna tam nekdo bydli. Kdyz jo,
mohli bychom se zeptat na {Color:Red}element{Color:White}?
Stoji za pokus, {Player}!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}So this perfectly normal-looking stone
was another {Color:Blue}portal{Color:White} to the Minish world!
There may be other {Color:Blue}rock portals{Color:White}. Keep
your eyes peeled, boy...
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Takze tento normalne vypadajici
kamen byl dalsi {Color:Blue}portal{Color:White} do sveta Minish!
Mohou existovat dalsi {Color:Blue}kamenne portaly{Color:White}.
Mej oci na strope, chlapce...

en:
{Sound:00:8E}That's right! Even some human objects
are {Color:Blue}portals{Color:White} to the Minish world!
Those Minish may not look like much,
but they are quite crafty!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Presne tak! I nektere lidske predmety
jsou {Color:Blue}portaly{Color:White} do sveta Minish!
Minish sice moc nevypadaji,
ale jsou docela vychytrali!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}What? ...What is this?
What's happened here!?
They've been turned to stone! All of
them! The minister...and the guards!
Everyone in the castle, all just
like {Color:Green}Princess Zelda{Color:White}...
This can only be the work of that evil
Vaati! What cruelty. {Player}!
We must use the power of the sacred
{Color:Red}Four Sword{Color:White} to {Color:Blue}undo this evil{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Co? ...Co to je?
Co se tu stalo!?
Bylili promeneni v kamen! Vsichni!
Ministr...a strazci!
Vsichni v hradu, uplne jako
{Color:Green}princezna Zelda{Color:White}...
Toto muze byt jen dilo toho zleho
Vaatiho! Jaka kruost. {Player}!
Musime pouzit silu posvatneho
{Color:Red}Ctyrmece{Color:White}, at {Color:Blue}zrusime toto zlo{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Once you've pulled off their {Color:Blue}iron masks{Color:White},
those guys are no trouble whatsoever.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Kdyz jim strhnes {Color:Blue}zelezne masky{Color:White},
ti chlapi nejsou zadny problem.

en:
{Sound:00:92}Your sword won't make a dent in their
thorny armor!
{Color:Blue}Flip them over{Color:White} before you strike!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Tvuj mec nezanecha skvrnu na jejich
trnitem brneni!
{Color:Blue}Prevrat je{Color:White}, nez uderis!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}Don't panic, {Player}! {Color:Blue}Only one of
them is real!{Color:White} The rest are fakes!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Nepropadej panice, {Player}! {Color:Blue}Jenom
jeden je skutecny!{Color:White} Ostatni jsou falesne!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}With their {Color:Blue}stone masks{Color:White} on, these
things can put up quite a fight.
If you just unmask them, though, they
won't pose much of a threat.
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}S {Color:Blue}kamennymi maskami{Color:White} nasazenymi
se tyhle veci umi rvat.
Ale kdyz jim strhnes masky,
neni s nimi zadny problem.

{04:10:00}Hm?! Hmmmmnnnn...
Aha, jasne! Ja hlupak!{Sound:00:92}
Hej, chlapce! {Color:Blue}Skoc do toho
viru{Color:White} tamhle pro me!
He he he... Je to skvely napad
nebo hrozny?

en:
{Sound:00:8D}Whoa! How about that?! Of all the
places for them to hide a portal!
You've done well, my boy. Was that
intuition? Or...just a lucky guess?{Sound:00:90}
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Ou! Co ty na to?! Ze vsech mist,
kde schovali portal!
Udelal jsi to dobre, chlapce.
Byla to intuice? Nebo...jen stesti?{Sound:00:90}

en:
{Sound:00:90}Hmn? There's something fishy about
this area...
I can't say exactly what, though...
Just something weird in general...
Don't you feel it?
cz:
{Sound:00:90}Hm? Neco je na teto oblasti
podezreleho...
Nerikam presne co, ale...
Proste neco divneho...
Necitis to taky?

en:
{Sound:00:92}Whoa! So there WAS a portal
hidden there!
I knew I sensed something!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Ou! Takze tam PORTAL byl
schovany!
Vedel jsem, ze neco citim!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}So, this must be {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White}...

It's a nasty, dank place, filled with
swampland and mire...
But we know there's an {Color:Red}element{Color:White} waiting
for us somewhere in here, so...
In we go! Come on, {Player}!
Into the muck with us!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Takze tohle musi byt {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White}...

Nechutne, vlhke misto plne
mocalu a baziny...
Ale vime, ze tu na nas nekde ceka
{Color:Red}element{Color:White}, takze...
Jdeme dovnitr! No tak, {Player}!
Do bahna s nami!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Now, that is one nasty-looking statue!
That {Color:Blue}eye{Color:White} has such an evil glower to it.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Tohle je hodne oskliva socha!
To {Color:Blue}oko{Color:White} ma takovy zly pohled.

en:
{Sound:00:92}There's only one thing to do here. Just
break those pots that are in the way!
Stand in front of them and press {Key:Right}
to {Color:Blue}lift them over your head{Color:White}.
Then press it again to {Color:Blue}throw them{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Je jenom jedna vec, co delat.
Rozbij ty hrnce, co jsou v ceste!
Postav se pred ne a stiskni {Key:Right},
abys je {Color:Blue}zvedl nad hlavu{Color:White}.
Pak stiskni znovu a {Color:Blue}hod' je{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:00:92}With this {Color:Red}small key{Color:White}, we should be able
to open any locked door here!
But I should warn you, {Color:Blue}once you've
used the key{Color:White}, {Color:Blue}it will vanish{Color:White} forever.
To use it, just stand in front of
a locked door and press {Key:Right}.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}S timhle {Color:Red}malym klicem{Color:White} bychom meli
zvladnout otevrit jakekoliv zamcene dvere!
Ale varuji te, {Color:Blue}jak klic pouzijes{Color:White},
{Color:Blue}zmizi{Color:White} navzdy.
Staci se postavit pred zamcene
dvere a stisknout {Key:Right}.

en:
{Sound:00:92}Do you see that lever? I think you
should be able to {Color:Blue}pull it{Color:White}.
Just stand in front of it and press {Key:Right}
to grab it, then press {Key:DDown} to pull.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Vidis tu paku? Mel bys
zvladnout ji {Color:Blue}vytahnout{Color:White}.
Staci se pred ni postavit, stisknout
{Key:Right}, at ji chytnes, a pak {Key:DDown}.

en:
{Sound:00:92}Once you take hold of something with
{Key:Right}, use {Key:Dpad} to {Color:Blue}push{Color:White} or {Color:Blue}pull{Color:White} it.
This is extremely important, so I hope
you take pains to remember it!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Jak neco chytnes pomoci
{Key:Right}, pouzij {Key:Dpad} k {Color:Blue}tlaceni{Color:White} nebo {Color:Blue}tazeni{Color:White}.
Je to hodne dulezite, tak si to
snaz zapamatovat!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Wow! Look at the size of that barrel!

Hm? Oh, right! Right! How silly of me!
It's not big{Symbol:16} {Color:Blue}we're just small{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Wau! Podivej, jak je ten sud
velky!
Hm? Aha, jasne! Ja hlupak!
Neni velky{Symbol:16} {Color:Blue}my jsme mali{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Wha--!? Hey, be careful, my lad!
{Color:Blue}The barrel just moved{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Co--!? Hej, opatrne, chlapce!
{Color:Blue}Ten sud se prave pohnul{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}What we need now is something to
hold down this switch...
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Ted' potrebujeme neco, co
pridrzi tento spinac...

en:
{Sound:00:90}Now what?

Unless we find a way to travel by
water, we won't be going much farther.
cz:
{Sound:00:90}Co ted?

Kdyz nenajdeme zpusob, jak
cestovat po vode, dal nedjdeme.

en:
{Sound:00:92}This must be what the humans who built
this mine used to get around in here.
Maybe we should hop in.

Hm? What? After all this, you don't
expect me to believe you're scared!
There's nothing to be afraid of here!
Come on, let's go!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Tohle asi pouzivali lide, kteri
staveli tento dul, k pohybu.
Mozna bychom meli naskocit.

Hm? Co? Po tom vsem nemuzes
chtit, abych ti veril, ze mas strach!
Tady se neni ceho bat!
No tak, jdeme!

en:
{Sound:00:93}Sweet jumping jellyfish, that was awful!
Hey, kid, what are you smiling about?
I knew it was madness to risk our lives
in that rickety human contraption!
From now on, let's just stick to our
feet! Well, I mean...your feet.
cz:
{Sound:00:93}Sladke skacici meduzy, to bylo hrozne!
Hej, kluku, cemu se usmivas?
Vedel jsem, ze je sileny riskovat
zivot v tom vratkem lidskem strojku!
Od ted' se drzme jenom nasich
nohou! No, myslim...tvych nohou.

en:
{Sound:00:91}Oh my! It looks really, REALLY
hot in that lava!
Trust me: falling into that would
be a bad idea. I'm sure you agree.
cz:
{Sound:00:91}No teda! V te lave to vypada
fakt, FAKT horko!
Ver mi: spadnout tam by byl
spatny napad. Souhlasis, vim to.

en:
{Sound:00:8E}How interesting! So there was a {Color:Blue}portal{Color:White}
hidden away in here, hm?
Whenever you want me to shrink you
down, just hop up here and press {Key:Right}!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Jak zajimave! Takze tu byl schovany
{Color:Blue}portal{Color:White}, hm?
Kdykoliv chces, abych te zmensil,
naskoc sem a stiskni {Key:Right}!

en:
{Sound:00:90}Phew...! We barely made it! I was
certain we'd run out of time!
cz:
{Sound:00:90}Uf...! Sotva jsme to stihli!
Byl jsem si jisty, ze nam dojde cas!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Hmn?! Did something just fall down,
or was it just my imagination?
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Hm?! Prave neco spadlo,
nebo je to jen ma fantazie?

en:
{Sound:00:91}What?! This floor is made out of ice!

Be careful not to fall and freeze
your backside to the floor, {Player}!
cz:
{Sound:00:91}Co?! Tahle podlaha je z ledu!

Davej pozor, at nespadnes a nezmrznes
zadeckem k podlaze, {Player}!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Hm. It looks like something is frozen
inside this block of ice...
{Player}, why don't you go take a
look?
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Hm. Vypada to, ze neco je zamrzle
uvnitr toho kusu ledu...
{Player}, nemel by ses jit
podivat?

en:
{Sound:00:92}Hey! The sunlight's shining through!

Ahhh... It's so nice and warm. I can
feel myself starting to defrost again.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Hej! Slunecni svetlo proniklo!

Ahh... Je to prijemne teple.
Citim, jak zase rozmrzam.

en:
{Sound:00:92}{04:10:00}Hey...!!

Well done, {Player}!
This looks to be the {Color:Red}element{Color:White}, all right.
But what will we do?

We can't even touch it while it's
trapped in that ice...
We'll need to melt it off somehow...
cz:
{Sound:00:92}{04:10:00}Hej...!!

Vyborne, {Player}!
Vypada to jako {Color:Red}element{Color:White}, jasne.
Ale co udelame?

Nemuzeme se ho ani dotknout,
kdyz je zamrzly v ledu...
Musime ho nejak roztavit...

en:
{Sound:00:92}Of course! Sunlight! Once we get some
sunlight in to melt the ice,
that {Color:Red}element {Color:White}will be as good as ours!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Jasne! Slunecni svetlo! Kdyz
sem dostaneme svetlo, at rozehreje
led, ten {Color:Red}element {Color:White}bude nas!

en:
{Sound:00:92}We did it, {Player}!
Now we can take the {Color:Red}element{Color:White}!
That was a lot of trouble,
but we finally did it, and...
What in blazes!?

Hey, something's not right here!!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Zvladli jsme to, {Player}!
Ted' muzeme vzit {Color:Red}element{Color:White}!
Bylo to hodne zabrani, ale
konecne jsme to dokazali, a...
Co to sakra!?

Hej, neco je tu spatne!!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}What!? What's this?!

That stupid Octorok stole our {Color:Red}element{Color:White}!

Don't just stand there! We've got to go
get it! {Player}! Now!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Co!? Co je to?!

Ten blby Octorok nam ukradl {Color:Red}element{Color:White}!

Nestuj tu! Musime ho dostat zpet!
{Player}! Ted'!

en:
{Sound:00:91}{Player}! Where are you?
Are you still there under me?
It's so dark, I can't see my beak
in front of my face!
Watch your step! I don't want you
to trip over anything...
cz:
{Sound:00:91}{Player}! Kde jsi?
Jsi porad tam pode mnou?
Je tak tma, ze nevidim svuj zobak
pred oblicejem!
Davej pozor, kam slapes! Nechci,
abys o neco zakopl...

en:
{Sound:00:92}Oh my! There was a portal hidden
in there?
cz:
{Sound:00:92}No teda! Tam byl schovany
portal?

en:
{Sound:00:92}There's a fluffy cloud floating here.
It looks awfully comfortable.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Tady se vznasi nadychany mrak.
Vypada strasne pohodlne.

en:
{Sound:00:8E}That panel... I think if we stomped on
it hard enough, it might flip over...
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Ten panel... Myslim, ze kdybychom
na nej dupli dost silne, obrati se...

en:
{Sound:00:92}There's a strong gale blowing here!
Try not to get swept away!
And hold on to your hat!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Tady fouka silna vichrice!
Nenech se odfouknout!
A drz si klobouk!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Perhaps your sword could reflect the
blasts coming from those statues.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Mozna by tvuj mec mohl odrazit
vystrely z techto soch.

en: {Sound:00:92}What in the world is that?!
cz: {Sound:00:92}Co to sakra je?!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Hmmm... Yes, yes... It certainly
does look suspicious...
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Hmmm... Ano, ano... Vypada to
urcite podezrele...

en: {Sound:00:91}Huh? Wha--? What in the world!?
cz: {Sound:00:91}Co? Co--? Co to sakra!?

en: {Sound:00:8F}My word! It's a treasure chest!
cz: {Sound:00:8F}No teda! Truhla s pokladem!

en: {Sound:00:8F}There seems to be a switch here!
cz: {Sound:00:8F}Vypada to, ze tady je spinac!

en:
{Sound:00:8F}Oh, a {Color:Red}Piece of Heart{Color:White}!
Well, that IS useful.
cz:
{Sound:00:8F}Ach, {Color:Red}Kousek srdce{Color:White}!
To je opravdu uzitecne.

en:
{Sound:00:8E}So this is your house...
Well, it seems like a nice place.
...So, where's my room?
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Tak tohle je tvuj dum...
Vypada jako fajn misto.
...Tak kde je muj pokoj?

en:
{Sound:00:90}So! This is your room? That makes it
my room, too, right?
cz:
{Sound:00:90}Tak! Tohle je tvuj pokoj?
Znamena to, ze je i muj, ze?

en:
{Sound:00:92}I sense something unusual here...
Is it something hidden?
I won't tell anyone, so come on!
Show me!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Citim tady neco nezvykleho...
Je to neco schovaneho?
Nikomu to nereknu, tak no tak!
Ukaz mi to!

en:
{Sound:00:90}Why, this is the shopkeeper
Stockwell's house!
You can tell much about a person
from the house he keeps, hm?
It's pretty unusual, even by Hyrulean
standards. It even has a pool!
cz:
{Sound:00:90}No, tohle je dum obchodnika
Stockwella!
O cloveku hodne poznas z toho,
jaky ma dum, ze?
Je docela neobvykly i podle
hyrulskych standardu. Ma i bazen!

en:
{Sound:00:92}That mustachioed guy strikes me as
somewhat unreliable.
There's something fishy about this
room, too.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Ten chlap s knirem mi pripada
trochu nespolehlivy.
I na tomhle pokoji je neco
podezreleho.

en:
{Sound:00:90}Sniff sniff sniff! Mmmm, doesn't that
smell spectacular?
Perhaps they give out free samples.
I say, would you...ask for me?
cz:
{Sound:00:90}Vzdych vzdych! Mmmm, nevoni to
uzasne?
Mozna davaji vzorky zdarma.
Hele, nezeptas se...za me?

en:
{Sound:00:8E}There seem to be many interesting
books in here...
  {Color:Blue}Hyrule on 10 Rupees a Day{Color:White},
  {Color:Blue}So Your Son Wants to Be a Hero{Color:White}...
  {Color:Blue}It Could Be Verse!{Color:White}, by Percy, and
  {Color:Blue}Rem's Anthology for Sleepless Nights{Color:White}.
Hmmm, they all look pretty good,
but which one to read first?
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Vypada to, ze je tu spousta
zajimavych knih...
  {Color:Blue}Hyrule za 10 rupii denne{Color:White},
  {Color:Blue}Kdyz chce vas syn byt hrdina{Color:White}...
  {Color:Blue}Mohla by to byt verse!{Color:White} od Percyho a
  {Color:Blue}Remova antologie na probdele noci{Color:White}.
Hmmm, vsechny vypadaji dobre,
ale kterou cist prvni?

en:
{Sound:00:92}Are you sure I look all right? I never
know what to wear to formal occasions.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Vypadam v poradku? Nikdy nevim,
co si vzit na formalni prilezitosti.

en:
{Sound:00:92}How tranquil...
And those cows look so...delicious.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Jak klidne...
A ty kravy vypadaji tak...chutne.

en:
{Sound:00:92}Whoa! Did you see that cat looking
at me?! I know it wants a piece of me!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Ou! Videl jsi, jak se na me
ta kocka koukala?! Chce me sezrat!

en:
{Sound:00:91}Waaah! That really startled me!
Everything's scary when you're small!
cz:
{Sound:00:91}Aaaaa! To me fakt vydesilo!
Kdyz jsi maly, vse je desive!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Hm? Whoa! It...blew up?

Hey, kid! Look at where that stone
marker used to be...
There's some strange {Color:Blue}symbol {Color:White}on the
ground.
Yes, of course{01:0A}... Why, this must be...

{01:01}...Well, I haven't the foggiest, to be
honest. Hm...
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Hm? Ou! Ono...vybouchlo?

Hej, kluku! Podivej, kde byval
ten kamen...
Je tam nejaky podivny {Color:Blue}symbol {Color:White}na
zemi.
Ano, jasne{01:0A}... To musi byt...

{01:01}...No, uprimne, nemam tuseni.
Hm...

en:
{Sound:00:92}Hey! That stone marker crumbled! And
there's another of those {Color:Blue}symbols{Color:White}!
...You know, no matter how many times
I see that happen, it still rattles me.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Hej! Ten kamen se rozpadl! A je
tu dalsi z tech {Color:Blue}symbolu{Color:White}!
...Vis, at' to vidim jakkoli
casto, porad me to prekvapuje.

en:
{Sound:00:92}Hey! We've found another {Color:Blue}Wind Crest{Color:White}!

Now we have one more point of travel
when we use the {Color:Red}Ocarina of Wind{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Hej! Nasli jsme dalsi {Color:Blue}Znak vetru{Color:White}!

Ted' mame dalsi bod pro cestovani,
kdyz pouzijeme {Color:Red}Okarinu vetru{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Aha!! So that mysterious mark we've
been seeing is a {Color:Blue}Wind Crest{Color:White}.
If you play the {Color:Red}Ocarina of Wind{Color:White}, Zeffa
comes to pick you up and fly you away.
That means we can have Zeffa carry us
to any other {Color:Blue}Wind Crest{Color:White} we've seen.
Are you following me, {Player}?
Don't hurt your brain thinking about it.
Just give it a try, and you'll see what
I'm talking about.
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Aha!! Takze ten tajemny znak,
co vidime, je {Color:Blue}Znak vetru{Color:White}.
Kdyz zahrajes na {Color:Red}Okarinu vetru{Color:White},
Zeffa prileti a odnese te.
Zeffa nas donese na kterykoliv
dalsi {Color:Blue}Znak vetru{Color:White}, co jsme videli.
Stihas me, {Player}?
Nelam si s tim hlavu.
Proste to zkus a uvidis, o cem
mluvim.

en:
{Sound:00:92}Hmn?!
Say, look at that, {Player}!
There's a {Color:Red}book {Color:White}up on top of the
bookcase!
But how are we going to get it? We
can't reach it, and we have no ladder.
And I don't think just shaking the
bookcase will make it fall, either.
This presents an interesting
problem, wouldn't you say?
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Hm?!
Hej, podivej, {Player}!
Na vrsku knihovny je
{Color:Red}kniha{Color:White}!
Ale jak ji dostaneme? Nedosahneme
na ni a nemame zebrik.
A nemyslim, ze staci s knihovnou
zatrast, aby spadla.
Zajimavy problem, nemyslis?

en:
{Sound:00:8D}Hey now! You can't just go waltzing
into people's homes like that!
If the owner isn't home, you'll just
have to come back later.
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Hej ted'! Nemuzes jen tak vpadnout
lidem do domu!
Kdyz majitel neni doma, budes
se muset vratit pozdeji.

en:
{Sound:00:92}Hm. This house appears to be empty...
Maybe we shouldn't go in here.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Hm. Tento dum se zda byt prazdny...
Mozna bychom sem nemeli chodit.

en:
{Sound:00:92}Hm? That's unfortunate...
They're not open yet.
Ah, well. We'll just have to come
back later, won't we?
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Hm? To je smutne...
Jeste nemaji otevreno.
No dobre. Budeme se muset vratit
pozdeji, ze?

en:
{Sound:00:8E}The door is shut.
We can't open it from this side{01:0A}...
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Dvere jsou zavrene.
Z teto strany je neotevreme{01:0A}...

en:
{Sound:00:8D}Hey, you don't have any {Color:Red}Kinstone
pieces{Color:White}!
How can you fuse Kinstones if you
don't have any Kinstone pieces!?
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Hej, ty nemas zadne {Color:Red}kousky
Kamene osudu{Color:White}!
Jak muzes spojovat Kameny osudu,
kdyz nemas zadne kousky!?

en:
{Sound:00:90}I don't think we can walk fast enough
to cross this swamp.
We're going to have to find some way
to get across safely...
cz:
{Sound:00:90}Myslim, ze nedokazeme jit dost
rychle, abychom prosli bahno.
Musime najit zpusob, jak
prejit bezpecne...

en:
{Sound:00:92}Hey, kid! Why don't you take that {Color:Red}Cane
of Pacci{Color:White} and fire it at that hole?
I mean, you never know what'll happen
until you try, right?
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Hej, kluku! Zkus tu {Color:Red}Pacciho
hulku{Color:White} a vystrel ji do te diry.
Nikdy nevis, co se stane,
dokud to nezkusis, ze?

en:
{Sound:00:91}Oooooog. I'm sure I've mentioned this
before, but I'm no good with heights.
Wait, hold on... I think I see
something down there!
Sigh... I guess that means we have to
take the plunge after all, hm?
cz:
{Sound:00:91}Uuuuuf. Urcite jsem to uz
rikal, ale vysky mi nedelaji.
Pockej, vydrz... Myslim, ze
vidim neco tam dole!
Vzdych... To asi znamena, ze
musime skocit, ze?

en:
{Sound:00:92}Hmph! There's a {Color:Red}locked{Color:White} door here! See if
you can find a key to open it.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Hmpf! Tady jsou {Color:Red}zamcene{Color:White} dvere!
Zkus najit klic, abys je otevrel.

en:
{Sound:00:92}That noise just now! What was that?
Something must have happened...
Be careful, {Player}!!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Ten hluk ted'! Co to bylo?
Neco se muselo stat...
Opatrne, {Player}!!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Hmm! Yes, yes, yes! Why, it all makes
sense now, doesn't it, boy?
{Color:Green}Librari{Color:White} used these {Color:Red}flippers {Color:White}to swim to
the entrance to the {Color:Green}Temple of Droplets{Color:White}.
So, if you put these on, you should be
able to swim, too! Remarkable!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Hmm! Ano, ano, ano! Ted' to vse
dava smysl, ze, chlapce?
{Color:Green}Librari{Color:White} pouzil tyto {Color:Red}plovaky {Color:White}k plavani
ke vchodu do {Color:Green}Chramu kapek{Color:White}.
Takze kdyz si je nasadis, mel
bys taky plavat! Uzasne!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}If I recall correctly, and I guarantee
that I do, my boy...
I think Syrup said to stand in front of
a sleeping person and press {Key:Right}.
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Jestli si pamatuji spravne, a
zarucuji ti to, chlapce...
Syrup rikala, ze se mas postavit
ped spici osobu a stisknout {Key:Right}.

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Now there's a puzzler...{01:0A}

{01:01}I suspect there's not much more we can
do here right now. Let's press on.
Perhaps we can work this from another
angle later on.
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}To je zahada...{01:0A}

{01:01}Nemyslim, ze tu ted' muzeme udelat
vic. Pojd'me dal.
Mozna to zvladneme z jineho uhlu
pozdeji.

en:
{Sound:00:8E}That hand is a real pain, {Player}.

Perhaps one of those gizmos you carry
around can do something to it!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Ta ruka je fakt otrava, {Player}.

Mozna nejaka z tech vecicek, co
nosis, s ni neco udela!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}What!? I haven't even had time to
settle in, and you're bothering me?
{Color:Green}Deepwood Shrine{Color:White} lies, obviously enough,
deep in the heart of these woods!
So says my superior intuitive sense.
{01:05}Now, get a move on!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Co!? Jeste jsem se ani neusadil,
a ty me otravujes?
{Color:Green}Deepwood Shrine{Color:White} lezi, jasne,
hluboko v srdci teto lesa!
Rika muj vynikajici intuitivni smysl.
{01:05}Ted' pohyb!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}This place is dangerous...
There are so many monsters.
{01:06}Kid! Be careful!
{01:05}You wouldn't want to let them hurt me!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Tohle misto je nebezpecne...
Je tu tolik nestvur.
{01:06}Kluku! Opatrne!
{01:05}Nechces mi prece nechat ublizit!

en:
{Sound:00:92}"Check your surroundings to make
sure there's nothing hidden!"
That's the cardinal rule of
adventuring! {01:07}So don't you forget it!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}"Prohledej okoli, at zjistis,
ze nic neni schovane!"
To je zakladni pravidlo
dobrodruzstvi! {01:07}Nezapomen na to!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Sometimes, a way will open for you
{Color:Blue}when you are smaller{Color:White}.
You've got to try everything
you can, my boy!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Nekdy se ti cesta otevre,
{Color:Blue}kdyz jsi mensi{Color:White}.
Musis zkusit vsechno,
co muzes, chlapce!

en:
{Sound:00:92}The {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}are exceptionally tiny!

That means, when you're their size,
you can fit into some {Color:Blue}pretty tiny spots{Color:White}!
That includes places you couldn't
go at your normal size.
That's a pretty good tip, huh?
cz:
{Sound:00:92}{Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}jsou vyjimecne male!

To znamena, kdyz jsi jejich
velikost, vlezes do {Color:Blue}fakt malych mist{Color:White}!
Vcetne mist, kam se v normalni
velikosti nedostanes.
Docela dobra rada, co?

en:
{Sound:00:8D}Hey, kid! Maybe now you'll have a little
respect for me, huh?
That's right! I can turn you tiny
anytime you want!
{01:0A}Well, that is, if there's a stump{01:01} or
some other kind of {Color:Blue}portal{Color:White} nearby...
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Hej, kluku! Ted' me mozna trochu
respektujes, ha?
Presne! Muzu te zmensit kdykoli
chces!
{01:0A}No, teda, kdyz je pobliz pen{01:01}
nebo jiny {Color:Blue}portal{Color:White}...

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Hm. We're not going to get anywhere
if the Minish can't understand you{01:0A}...
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Hm. Nikam se nedostaneme,
kdyz ti Minish nerozumeji{01:0A}...

en:
{Sound:00:90}The {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}certainly do seem to be
curious about the ways of humans...
cz:
{Sound:00:90}{Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}jsou urcite zvedavi
na zvyky lidi...

en:
{Sound:00:92}"Don't ponder{Symbol:16} wander!"

Don't waste your time trying to
think things through too quickly.
Take your time! Look around {Color:Green}Minish
Village{Color:White} and see what you can see!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}"Neuvazuj{Symbol:16} toulej se!"

Neplytvej casem snahou premyslet
vsechno prilis rychle.
Nespichej! Prochazej {Color:Green}Minish
Vesnici{Color:White} a mrkni, co uvidis!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}A strange nut that will allow us to
understand the Minish language{01:0A}...
{01:01}The {Color:Red}Jingle Nut{Color:White}, did he say...?
No, wait... That's not it...
Ah, I remember now! It was the
{Color:Red}Jabber Nut{Color:White}.
That's what it was... Come on, my boy!
We've got to find the {Color:Red}Jabber Nut{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Divny orech, ktery nam umozni
rozumet reci Minish{01:0A}...
{01:01}{Color:Red}Jingle Nut{Color:White}, rekl to tak...?
Ne, pockej... To neni ono...
Aha, vzpominam! Byl to
{Color:Red}Jabber Nut{Color:White}.
Tak to bylo... No tak, chlapce!
Musime najit {Color:Red}Jabber Nut{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}So that {Color:Red}Jabber Nut{Color:White} was, uhh...

Yeah, the {Color:Green}Minish with
glasses{Color:White} said,{01:0A} um...
Was his name Feltari?

{01:01}Anyway, we're supposed to go south
until we find a house {Color:Blue}inside a barrel{Color:White}.
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Takze ten {Color:Red}Jabber Nut{Color:White} byl, ehm...

Jo, ten {Color:Green}Minish s
brylemi{Color:White} rikal,{01:0A} ehm...
Jmenoval se Feltari?

{01:01}At tak nebo tak, mame jit na jih,
az najdeme dum {Color:Blue}v sudu{Color:White}.

en:
Once you've learned how to speak
the Minish language,
we'll be able to ask about the
{Color:Red}sacred blade{Color:White}. {Sound:00:8D}Let's get to it!
cz:
Az se naucis mluvit
reci Minish,
budeme se moci zeptat na
{Color:Red}posvatnou cepel{Color:White}. {Sound:00:8D}Jdeme na to!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Well? What are you waiting for? You
can understand their language, right?
So stop wasting time and find out
about that sacred blade!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Tak? Na co cekas? Rozumis
jejich reci, ze?
Tak neplytvej casem a zjisti
o te posvatne cepeli!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}So only the {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}can repair
the {Color:Red}sword{Color:White}, hm?
Maybe we should find out what the
other {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}know about that.
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Takze jen {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}umi opravit
{Color:Red}mec{Color:White}, hm?
Mozna bychom meli zjistit, co
o tom vedi ostatni {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}.

en:
{Sound:00:8D}You've never actually seen the
{Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}before, have you?
Ah, well, they are mostly good
folk. Yes{01:0A}...mostly...
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Nikdys skutecne nevidel
{Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}predtim, ze?
Ach, no, jsou to vetsinou
sluzni lide. Ano{01:0A}...vetsinou...

en:
{Sound:00:8E}If you have any hopes of reforging the
sacred blade, do as the elder says.
Go find the {Color:Red}Earth Element{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Kdyz doufas, ze pretavis
posvatnou cepel, poslechni starsiho.
Jdi najit {Color:Red}Zemsky element{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}A Minish shrine filled with monsters?

{Sound:00:8D}It sounds dangerous in there!{01:0A} We'd
better be careful...
{01:01}I mean, you'd better be careful!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Minish svatyne plna nestvur?

{Sound:00:8D}Zni to tam nebezpecne!{01:0A} Radeji
budme opatrni...
{01:01}Chci rict, radeji bud' opatrny!

en:
{Sound:00:92}What? Don't tell me you're lost!

Listen, if you get lost, just {Color:Blue}examine
your surroundings{Color:White} closely...
I'm sure you can find some kind
of clue nearby.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Co? Nerikej mi, ze jsi ztraceny!

Poslys, kdyz zabloudis, jen
{Color:Blue}poradne prohledej okoli{Color:White}...
Jsem si jist, ze nekde blizko
najdes nejakou stopu.

en:
{Sound:00:8E}We got through that monster-filled
shrine and found the {Color:Red}Earth Element{Color:White}!
{Sound:00:92}Great work, kid! You're doing a fine
job! Thanks to my help, of course.
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Prosli jsme svatyni plnou nestvur
a nasli {Color:Red}Zemsky element{Color:White}!
{Sound:00:92}Super prace, kluku! Vede se ti
dobre! Diky me pomoci, samozrejme.

en:
{Sound:00:8E}The Minish elder wanted us to speak
with him once we found that {Color:Red}element{Color:White}.
That's where we ought to go.
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Minish starsi chtel, abychom s nim
mluvili, az najdeme {Color:Red}element{Color:White}.
Tam bychom meli jit.

en:
{Sound:00:8E}{01:0A}We need to learn how to reforge
the broken {Color:Red}sacred blade{Color:White}.
{01:01}{Color:Green}We'll have to speak with the Minish
elder {Color:White}about that, won't we?
{Sound:00:8D}Well? What are you waiting for!? Evil
won't go vanquishing itself, you know!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}{01:0A}Musime se naucit, jak pretavit
zlomenou {Color:Red}posvatnou cepel{Color:White}.
{01:01}{Color:Green}Musime o tom mluvit se starsim
Minish{Color:White}, ze?
{Sound:00:8D}Tak? Na co cekas!? Zlo se samo
neporazi, vis!

en:
{Sound:00:92}So we're supposed to meet a Minish
blacksmith named {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White} on {Color:Green}Mt. Crenel{Color:White}?
You know, maybe we should stop in at
the town of Hyrule before leaving...
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Takze mame potkat Minish kovare
jmenem {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White} na {Color:Green}Mt. Crenel{Color:White}?
Vis, mozna bychom se meli zastavit
v meste Hyrule, nez vyrazime...

en:
{Sound:00:8D}What's the matter? Are you lost?

Just where do you think you're
taking us, anyway?
Look at a {Color:Red}map {Color:White}or something! Just
press START to see it.
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Co se deje? Jsi ztraceny?

Kam si vlastne myslis, ze
nas vedes?
Podivej se na {Color:Red}mapu {Color:White}nebo neco!
Stiskni START, at ji vidis.

en:
{Sound:00:92}Have you ever visited Hyrule before?

What? You have?
...What's it like?
{Sound:00:8D}Not that I... I mean, I've seen it
before! Of course I have!
I'm very well traveled. I just wanted
to see...what you thought of it!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Byls uz nekdy v Hyrule?

Co? Ano?
...Jake to je?
{Sound:00:8D}Ne, ze... Chci rict, videl jsem to
predtim! Samozrejme!
Jsem svetoznamy cestovatel. Chtel
jsem jen videt...co si o tom myslis!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}{Color:Green}Mount Crenel{Color:White} is a forbidding and
rocky place with many steep cliffs.
It lies just west of {Color:Green}Hyrule Town{Color:White}.

We ought to equip ourselves in town
before risking the journey.
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}{Color:Green}Mount Crenel{Color:White} je strasidelne
a skalnate misto s mnoha utesy.
Lezi hned zapadne od {Color:Green}mesta Hyrule{Color:White}.

Meli bychom se vybavit v meste,
nez pujdeme.

en:
{Sound:00:92}Look at all these shops! This is so
different from {Color:Green}Minish Village{Color:White}!
I-I-I... I can't decide where to
go next!
Come on, my boy! Let's go shopping!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Podivej na ty obchody! Je to
tak jine nez {Color:Green}Minish Vesnice{Color:White}!
J-j-j... Nemuzu se rozhodnout,
kam ted' jit!
No tak, chlapce! Pojd'me nakupovat!

{Sound:00:92}Ach, nerikej, ze uz jsi to
zapomnel! Co je S TEBOU?
Minish starsi nam rekl, at
jdeme za {Color:Green}Melarim{Color:White} na {Color:Green}Mount Crenel{Color:White}.
{Sound:00:90}Ale jak si myslis, ze vylezeme
na tu hromadu kameni?{01:0A}

en:
{Sound:00:8D}Oh, hey! I totally forgot!

That sword technique you learned from
the swordsman...
The {Color:Red}Spin Attack{Color:White}, that's what it's
called, right? That is so incredible!
{Sound:00:92}Do you think you could teach
it to me sometime?
Hm?! Hey! Don't give me that look!
I can do anything that you can do!
{Sound:00:8D}Just give me some arms, and I'll
show you what's what!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Ach, hej! Uplne jsem zapomnel!

Ta technika s mecem, co ses naucil
od sermire...
{Color:Red}Toceny utok{Color:White}, tak se to jmenuje,
ze? To je uzasne!
{Sound:00:92}Nemohl bys me to nekdy
naucit?
Hm?! Hej! Nedavej mi ten pohled!
Zvladnu vse, co zvladnes ty!
{Sound:00:8D}Dej mi ruce a ukazu ti to!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}A {Color:Blue}bean{Color:White} that {Color:Blue}grows{Color:White} when you {Color:Blue}pour water
{Color:White}on it{01:0A}...
{01:01}I guess it was a good idea to buy that
{Color:Red}bottle{Color:White} from the Deku Scrub after all!
{Sound:00:92}See, my boy? Listen to me,
and you'll go far!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}{Color:Blue}Fazol{Color:White}, ktery {Color:Blue}roste{Color:White}, kdyz na nej
{Color:Blue}nalejes vodu{Color:White}{01:0A}...
{01:01}Byl to dobry napad koupit tu
{Color:Red}lahvicku{Color:White} od Deku Scruba!
{Sound:00:92}Vidis, chlapce? Poslouchej me
a dojdes daleko!

en:
{Sound:00:90}Hrm... Where on {Color:Green}Mount Crenel {Color:White}is this
{Color:Green}Melari {Color:White}the blacksmith, anyway?
{Sound:00:92}Well, we know he's Minish, so try
to keep your eyes peeled!
cz:
{Sound:00:90}Hm... Kde na {Color:Green}Mount Crenel {Color:White}je ten
kovar {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White}?
{Sound:00:92}Vime, ze je Minish, tak
mej oci na strope!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Hey, kid! What's the matter?
You don't know which way to go?
At times like these, try everything you
can at spots that {Color:Blue}seem like dead ends{Color:White}!
Sometimes, you can find a way hidden in
the most unlikely of spots!
...Um, sometimes.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Hej, kluku! Co se deje?
Nevis, kam mas jit?
V takove chvili zkus vsechno na
mistech, co {Color:Blue}vypadaji jako slepa ulicka{Color:White}!
Nekdy najdes cestu na tom
nejmene ocekavanem miste!
...Ehm, nekdy.

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Hmm... It seems there are {Color:Blue}two types of
bean{Color:White} on Mount Crenel: blue and green.{01:0A}
{01:01}If the color is different, I suppose how
you treat each one is different, too.
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Hmm... Zda se, ze jsou {Color:Blue}dva druhy
fazoli{Color:White} na Mount Crenel: modre a zelene.{01:0A}
{01:01}Kdyz je barva jina, asi je jina
i to, jak s nimi zachazet.

en:
{Sound:00:92}Remember, we have to find our way to
the top of {Color:Green}Mount Crenel{Color:White}!
Once we're there, we'll start looking
for that {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White}.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Pamatuj, musime najit cestu na
vrchol {Color:Green}Mount Crenel{Color:White}!
Az tam budeme, zacneme hledat
{Color:Green}Melariho{Color:White}.

en:
{Sound:00:8D}Explain something to me, my boy...
Why are we just wandering around?
We're supposed to be scaling {Color:Green}Mount
Crenel{Color:White} and looking for {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Vysvetli mi neco, chlapce...
Proc se jen toulame kolem?
Mame slezat {Color:Green}Mount Crenel{Color:White}
a hledat {Color:Green}Melariho{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Somewhere on {Color:Green}Mount Crenel{Color:White}, there's
a Minish blacksmith named {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White}!
We have to find him!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Nekde na {Color:Green}Mount Crenel{Color:White} je
Minish kovar jmenem {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White}!
Musime ho najit!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}There are some strange creatures on
{Color:Green}Mount Crenel{Color:White}...
Creatures I've never seen before, and
your sword alone won't beat them!
Don't give up hope, though! Try your
other {Color:Red}items{Color:White} on them!
Well...you don't need me to tell you
how to do your job.
Just deal with those monsters, and
I'll take care of everything else.{01:0A}
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Na {Color:Green}Mount Crenel{Color:White} jsou divne
tvorove...
Tvory, co jsem nikdy nevidel,
a sam mec je neporazi!
Nevzdavej to! Zkus na ne jine
{Color:Red}predmety{Color:White}!
No...nepotrebujes, abych ti rikal,
jak delat svou praci.
Jen si porad s temi nestvurami
a ja se postaram o vse ostatni.{01:0A}

en:
{Sound:00:91}What?
You're lost again, aren't you?
Have you bothered reading any of
those {Color:Blue}signs{Color:White} we've been seeing?
You really ought to study them. They
might have some useful information!
...Not that I've been reading them
either...
cz:
{Sound:00:91}Co?
Zase jsi ztraceny, ze?
Cetl jsi vubec ty {Color:Blue}cedule{Color:White},
co vidime?
Mel bys je studovat. Mozna maji
nejake uzitecne informace!
...Teda, ani ja je necetl...

en:
{Sound:00:92}Hey! Hurry up and find that {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White},
so we can fix the sacred blade!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Hej! Pospes si a najdi {Color:Green}Melariho{Color:White},
abychom mohli opravit posvatnou cepel!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Have you noticed something odd about
the {Color:Green}Mountain Minish{Color:White}?
They're just a little different from
the Forest Minish, aren't they?
There seem to be many kinds of Minish,
just as there are many kinds of human.
And...many kinds of hat, too.
Mustn't forget the hats.
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Vsiml sis neceho podivneho na
{Color:Green}Horskych Minish{Color:White}?
Jsou trochu jini nez Lesni
Minish, ze?
Zda se, ze existuje mnoho druhu
Minish, stejne jako lidi.
A...mnoho druhu klobouku, taky.
Nesmime zapomenout na klobouky.

en:
{Sound:00:92}These Mountain {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}sure are
hard workers!
We should work just as hard and sing
a spiffy little song, like they do!
What do you think? Hey! Kid...?
Are you still listening to me?
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Ti Horski {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}jsou fakt
tvrdi pracovnici!
Meli bychom pracovat stejne
usilovne a zpivat jako oni!
Co mysils? Hej! Kluku...?
Jeste me posloucchas?

en:
{Sound:00:8D}This isn't the time to idle about,
you lazy boy!
We have to go search for the {Color:Red}elements{Color:White}
while Melari works on that sword!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Ted' neni cas se poflakovat,
tyleny kluku!
Musime hledat {Color:Red}elementy{Color:White},
zatim co Melari pracuje na meci!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}So humans made this mine long ago?

Well it's full of monsters now,
kid, so watch your back!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Takze lide postavili tento dul
davno?
Ted' je plny nestvur, kluku,
tak si hlidej zada!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Perhaps the humans who made this mine
will have left some things we can use...{01:0A}
{01:01}After all, there's no reason to let
good wares go to waste.
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Mozna lide, co postavili tento dul,
tu nechali veci, co pouzijeme...{01:0A}
{01:01}Neni duvod nechat dobre zbozi
prijit nazmar.

en:
{Sound:00:90}So we beat the fire monster and got
the second {Color:Red}element{Color:White}! Incredible!{01:0A}
{01:01}Kid, you may just be some kind of
hero or something!
{Sound:00:8D}I knew I sensed potential in you!
cz:
{Sound:00:90}Takze jsme porazili ohnivou nestvuru
a ziskali druhy {Color:Red}element{Color:White}! Neuveritelne!{01:0A}
{01:01}Kluku, mozna jsi nejaky
hrdina nebo tak neco!
{Sound:00:8D}Vedel jsem, ze v tobe citim potencial!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Oh, so I bet {Color:Green}Melari {Color:White}has finished with
that {Color:Red}sword{Color:White}. We should go pick it up!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Ach, sazim, ze {Color:Green}Melari {Color:White}uz s tim
{Color:Red}mecem{Color:White} skoncil. Meli bychom si ho vyzvednout!

en:
{Sound:00:92}So how about that sword that {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White}
fixed up for you, huh?
I may be just a hat, but I can admire
good craftsmanship!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Co rikas na ten mec, co pro tebe
{Color:Green}Melari{Color:White} opravil?
Mozna jsem jenom klobouk, ale
umim ocenit dobrou praci!

{Sound:00:8E}Musime najit {Color:Green}elementalni svatyni{Color:White},
abychom naplnili mec silou elementu.
Nikdy bych nehledal {Color:Green}elementalni
svatyni{Color:White} na {Color:Green}hrade Hyrule{Color:White}!{01:0A}
{01:01}Vis, jak se tam dostat, ze?
Jdeme!

en:
{Sound:00:92}So of the four {Color:Red}elements{Color:White}, we've got
Earth and Fire...
And now, we have the {Color:Red}White Sword{Color:White}
to absorb their power!
That means the sacred blade's power
has almost been restored!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Takze ze ctyr {Color:Red}elementu{Color:White} mame
Zemi a Ohen...
A ted' mame {Color:Red}Bily mec{Color:White},
aby vstrebal jejich silu!
To znamena, ze sila posvatne cepele
je skoro obnovena!

en:
{Sound:00:91}Why do you look so confused? Don't you
understand what's going on?{01:0A}
{01:01}The {Color:Green}elemental sanctuary {Color:White}exists between
the human world and the Minish world.
Here, let me explain with a little
example: in a ham sandwich...
the elemental sanctuary would be the
ham between the two slices of bread!
...You've still got that look.
Did I just make it more confusing?
cz:
{Sound:00:91}Proc vypadas tak zmatene?
Nechapes, co se deje?{01:0A}
{01:01}{Color:Green}Elementalni svatyne {Color:White}existuje mezi
lidskym svetem a svetem Minish.
Zkusim to vysvetlit priklem:
v sunkovem sendvici...
by elementalni svatyne byla sunka
mezi dvema kousky chleba!
...Porad tak koukas.
Zmatl jsem te vic?

en:
{Sound:00:92}I think that you and I may be the only
ones who can see the mystic doorway...
Well, that's fine by me. That means
no one will notice anything unusual!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Myslim, ze jenom my dva mozna
vidime ty mysticke dvere...
Mne to nevadi. Znamena to, ze
nikdo si nicehoho neobvykleho nevsimne!

en:
{Sound:00:92}We just need to infuse the {Color:Red}sword{Color:White} with
the power of these two {Color:Red}elements{Color:White}.
Then, the sacred blade will be
nearly complete!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Staci naplnit {Color:Red}mec{Color:White} silou
techto dvou {Color:Red}elementu{Color:White}.
Pak bude posvatna cepel
skoro dokoncena!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Only two {Color:Red}elements{Color:White} remain!

They must be in the places marked on
your {Color:Red}map{Color:White} by the Minish elder!
Why don't we take another look at that
map? If memory serves me correctly...{01:0A}
{01:01}There should be a mark out on the
westernmost edge of {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White}.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Zbyvaji jen dva {Color:Red}elementy{Color:White}!

Musi byt na mistech, co ti
na {Color:Red}mape{Color:White} oznacil Minish starsi!
Podivejme se znovu na tu
mapu. Jestli si pamatuji spravne...{01:0A}
{01:01}Mel by byt znak na nejzapadnejsim
okraji {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White}.

en:
{Sound:00:92}So the {Color:Red}sacred blade{Color:White} has finally started
to show us a portion of its power!
If we use this new skill of yours well,
we should be able to access new areas!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Takze {Color:Red}posvatna cepel{Color:White} nam konecne
zacala ukazovat kousek sve moci!
Kdyz tvou novou dovednost pouzijeme
dobre, dostaneme se do novych oblasti!

en:
{Sound:00:92}If you're after the {Color:Red}elements{Color:White}, just
check your {Color:Red}map{Color:White} by pressing START.
I believe the elder of the Forest
Minish marked the locations there.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Kdyz hledas {Color:Red}elementy{Color:White}, jen
mrkni na {Color:Red}mapu{Color:White} tlacitkem START.
Myslim, ze starsi Lesnich Minish
tam oznacil mista.

en:
{Sound:00:90}The swamp covering {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White} looks
{Color:Blue}impassable on foot{Color:White}. What will we do!?{01:0A}
cz:
{Sound:00:90}Bahno pokryvajici {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White}
vypada {Color:Blue}neschudne{Color:White}. Co udelame!?{01:0A}

en:
{Sound:00:92}{Player}, how long has it been since
you left home?
Your grandfather must be worried.
Why don't you show your face at home?
He must have plenty of news to share
with you by now.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}{Player}, jak dlouho uz jsi
pryc z domova?
Tvuj deda ma urcite starosti.
Nemel by ses ukazat doma?
Urcite ma spousty novinek,
o ktere se s tebou podeli.

en:
{Sound:00:92}Hoho! Well...

{Sound:00:8E}The big lake spreading out to the west
of Hyrule is {Color:Green}Lake Hylia{Color:White}.
The rich water that flows from it has
fed the {Color:Green}Minish Woods{Color:White} for millennia.
Every day, you learn something new,
don't you, {Player}?
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Hoho! No...

{Sound:00:8E}To velke jezero na zapade od
Hyrule je {Color:Green}Jezero Hylia{Color:White}.
Bohata voda, co z nej tece, zivi
{Color:Green}Minish les{Color:White} tisicileti.
Kazdy den se ucis neco noveho,
vid, {Player}?

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Well, I say! There seem to be a lot of
Minish living in town, too...
Even if they can't be seen, I'm sure the
Minish make their presence known...
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}No teda! Zda se, ze i v meste
zije spousta Minish...
I kdyz je nevidime, Minish o sobe
urcite davaji vedet...

en:
{Sound:00:92}So, about that {Color:Red}wake-up mushroom{Color:White} you
just bought... It kind of, um...smells.
COUGH! COUGH!

{Sound:00:91}I suppose that awful stink could pull
anyone from the deepest slumber!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Takze ta {Color:Red}houba na probuzeni{Color:White}, co
jsi koupil... Trochu, ehm...smrdi.
KAS! KAS!

{Sound:00:91}Ten strasny smrad by asi vyhnal
kohokoli z toho nejhlubsiho spanku!

en:
{Sound:00:90}Hey, {Player}. I've been up here for
a while, and I've been wondering...
I know about hats now, but I don't
know much about Hyrulean shoes...
Where could we go to learn a little
more about that?
cz:
{Sound:00:90}Hej, {Player}. Jsem tu uz
chvili a premyslim...
Vim o kloboucich, ale nevim
moc o hyrulskych botach...
Kam bychom mohli jit, abychom
se o tom naucili vic?

en:
{Sound:00:8E}So about that old lady in the woods
named {Color:Green}Syrup{Color:White} or something...
Didn't she strike you as a little
bit, well, strange?
