I'm confident that her {Color:Red}potions{Color:White} work
as advertised, though.
She looks like someone who could whip
up a mean magic brew...
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Ta stara pani v lese,
jmenem {Color:Green}Syrup{Color:White} nebo tak...
Nepripadala ti trochu, no,
divna?
Jsem si jisty, ze jeji {Color:Red}lektvary{Color:White}
fungujou, jak reklamou slibuje.
Vypada jako nekdo, kdo umi
dat dohromady posadny odvarek...

en:
{Sound:00:92}Once we cross {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White}, the
{Color:Red}element{Color:White} should be easy to find.
If you forget where to go, just take
a look at your {Color:Red}map{Color:White}.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Az prejdeme {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White},
{Color:Red}element{Color:White} by mel byt snadno k nalezeni.
Kdyz zapomenes, kam mas jit,
mrkni na svou {Color:Red}mapu{Color:White}.

en:
{Sound:00:8D}When you're crossing a swamp, you
want to be as swift as the wind...
There's no point in stopping to look
around. Sightseeing is right out!
What I'm trying to say is that I don't
much relish the thought of a mud bath!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Kdyz prechazis bazinu, chces
byt rychly jako vitr...
Nema smysl se zastavit a rozhlizet.
Prohlidka mist odpada!
Rikam, ze me netesi predstava
bahnite koupele!

en:
{Sound:00:92}That {Color:Blue}one-eyed stone{Color:White} statue in {Color:Green}Castor
Wilds{Color:White} looks like it's staring at us!
...That eye really creeps me out.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Ta {Color:Blue}jednooka socha{Color:White} v {Color:Green}Castor
Wilds{Color:White} vypada, jako by na nas zirala!
...To oko me fakt desi.

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Creepy {Color:Green}ruins{Color:White} standing on the far side
of {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White}...{01:0A}
{01:01}Maybe that's where the ancient people
who guarded the {Color:Red}element{Color:White} used to live.
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Strasidelne {Color:Green}ruiny{Color:White} na druhe strane
{Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White}...{01:0A}
{01:01}Mozna tam zili staroveci lide,
co strezili {Color:Red}element{Color:White}.

en:
{Sound:00:92}That {Color:Red}element {Color:White}is sure to be protected by
traps inside those ancient ruins!
{Player}, be careful!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Ten {Color:Red}element {Color:White}je urcite chranen
pastmi v tech starovekych ruinach!
{Player}, opatrne!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}Don't just wander around aimlessly...
That's the quickest way to get lost!
If you do get lost, look at your {Color:Red}map{Color:White}
immediately to get your bearings.
You will find your way only if you know
where you are AND where you're going.
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Nechod' jen tak bezcilne...
To je nejrychlejsi zpusob zabloudeni!
Kdyz zabloudis, hned se podivej
na {Color:Red}mapu{Color:White} pro orientaci.
Cestu najdes jen kdyz vis,
kde jsi A kam jdes.

en:
{Sound:00:92}The next {Color:Red}element{Color:White} is near {Color:Green}Lake Hylia{Color:White}.
Now, how are we going to get there?
I wonder who might be able to help
us out with something like that...
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Dalsi {Color:Red}element{Color:White} je u {Color:Green}Jezera Hylia{Color:White}.
Tak jak se tam dostaneme?
Zajimalo by me, kdo by nam s tim
mohl pomoct...

en:
{Sound:00:8D}All we have to do is use the {Color:Red}Ocarina of
Wind{Color:White} to call Zeffa!
If we stand on a {Color:Blue}Wind Crest{Color:White} and call
him, he'll take us where we want to go!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Staci pouzit {Color:Red}Okarinu
vetru{Color:White} a zavolat Zeffu!
Kdyz stojime na {Color:Blue}Znaku vetru{Color:White} a
zavolame ho, odveze nas, kam chceme!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}Well, now that we've got this {Color:Red}Ocarina
of Wind{Color:White}, shouldn't we try to use it?
Even places we've seen before may hold
new surprises if we try flying there...
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}No, ted' kdyz mame tu {Color:Red}Okarinu
vetru{Color:White}, nemeli bychom ji pouzit?
I mista, co jsme videli, mohou
chystat nova prekvapeni, kdyz priletime...

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Well, I'd never have suspected it of
that {Color:Green}Minish elder{Color:White} in the {Color:Green}library{Color:White}...
To think he was an adventurer! And
that he visited the {Color:Green}Temple of Droplets{Color:White}!
Maybe we should look up that {Color:Green}Librari{Color:White}
and hear what he has to say.
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}No, nikdy bych to nehadal o
tom {Color:Green}Minish starsim{Color:White} v {Color:Green}knihovne{Color:White}...
Ze byl dobrodruh! A ze navstivil
{Color:Green}Chram kapek{Color:White}!
Mozna bychom meli vyhledat toho
{Color:Green}Librariho{Color:White} a poslechnout, co rekne.

en:
{Sound:00:92}Hm. Now, how did {Color:Green}Librari{Color:White} get into
the {Color:Green}Temple of Droplets{Color:White}?
I guess we'll just have to go visit
him at the library and ask.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Hm. Jak se {Color:Green}Librari{Color:White} dostal do
{Color:Green}Chramu kapek{Color:White}?
Asi ho budeme muset navstivit
v knihovne a zeptat se.

en:
{Sound:00:92}So, where in the library would any
Minish folk live, anyway?
Maybe those people who say the Minish
exist "{Color:Blue}only in stories{Color:White}" might be right!
Hey! {Player}! What's that look for?
Don't tell me you were one of...them?
You're kidding me! You're wearing a
Minish person on your head, you oaf!
I certainly hope you believe in us now!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Tak kde v knihovne by byli
Minish, at' tak nebo tak?
Mozna maji pravdu ti, co rikaji,
ze Minish jsou "{Color:Blue}jen v pribezich{Color:White}"!
Hej! {Player}! Co je to za pohled?
Nerikej mi, ze jsi byl jeden z...
nich?
Zartujes! Mas Minish osobu
na hlave, tupce!
Doufam, ze v nas ted' veris!

en:
{Sound:00:91}How did we get roped into running all
over creation returning library books?
I understand it's all just to learn
how to enter the {Color:Green}Temple of Droplets{Color:White},
{Sound:00:8D}but this is hardly the sort of duty
worthy of a great adventurer!
cz:
{Sound:00:91}Jak jsme se zamotali do behani po
svete a vraceni knih do knihovny?
Chapu, ze to je jen abychom se
naucili, jak vstoupit do {Color:Green}Chramu kapek{Color:White},
{Sound:00:8D}ale tohle sotva je povinnost
hodna velkeho dobrodruha!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Minish people are very interested in
human ways.
I think they watch the people in
town very closely.
They've probably been watching you,
too, without your knowing it.
Hey, {Player}, careful what you say
and do when you think you're alone!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Minish jsou velmi zvedavi na
lidske zvyky.
Myslim, ze sleduji lidi v meste
dost zblizka.
Urcite sledovali i tebe, aniz
jsi to vedel.
Hej, {Player}, dej pozor, co delas
a rikas, kdyz si myslis, ze jsi sam!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}So there are three books that we're
supposed to return, right?
{Player}, I'm sure you can handle it!
Don't get me wrong! I'd love to help!
But I'm a great Minish sage! I don't
understand your big, human ways!
{Sound:00:8D}So...I'm counting on you!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Takze mame vratit tri knihy,
spravne?
{Player}, urcite to zvladnes!
Spatne me nepochop! Pomohl bych!
Ale jsem velky Minish mudrc!
Nerozumim vasim velkym lidskym zvykum!
{Sound:00:8D}Takze...spoleham na tebe!

en:
{Sound:00:91}This really is starting to take valuable
time from our search for the {Color:Red}element{Color:White}!
{Sound:00:92}But buck up, kiddo! We're almost
done, {Player}!!!
cz:
{Sound:00:91}Tohle nam zacina brat cenny cas
na hledani {Color:Red}elementu{Color:White}!
{Sound:00:92}Ale drz se, kluku! Uz jsme
skoro hotovi, {Player}!!!

{Sound:00:92}Nemuzu prijit na to, jak se
{Color:Green}Librari{Color:White} dostal do {Color:Green}Chramu kapek{Color:White}.
Zbavuji se ze zvedavosti!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}You know, even these Minish living in
the town still have their own troubles.
I feel like I've learned a lot here.
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Vis, i ti Minish, co ziji v meste,
maji svoje starosti.
Mam pocit, ze jsem se tu
hodne naucil.

en:
{Sound:00:92}The {Color:Green}Temple of Droplets{Color:White} holds the last of
the {Color:Red}elements{Color:White}, like the Minish elder said.
{Sound:00:8D}So let's brace ourselves and do this!
Are you ready, {Player}?!
... ...{01:0A}
{01:01}What?! What's that face for?
You don't want to brace yourself?! All
right, fine! No bracing! Let's just go!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}{Color:Green}Chram kapek{Color:White} ma posledni z
{Color:Red}elementu{Color:White}, jak rekl Minish starsi.
{Sound:00:8D}Tak se prichystej a jdeme na to!
Pripraven, {Player}?!
... ...{01:0A}
{01:01}Co?! Co je to za oblicej?
Nechces se pripravit?! Dobre,
dobre! Zadne pripravovani! Jdeme!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Did you know the {Color:Red}flippers{Color:White} Librari gave
you let you {Color:Blue}dive {Color:White}as well as {Color:Blue}swim{Color:White}?
They're good for avoiding things when
you're in the water...
And let's face it, if something hits you
in the head while you're swimming...
I'm going to be the one who gets
the worst of it.
So please, remember that. For my sake,
{Player}!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Vedel jsi, ze {Color:Red}plovaky{Color:White}, co ti dal
Librari, umi {Color:Blue}potapet {Color:White}i {Color:Blue}plavat{Color:White}?
Jsou dobre pro vyhybani, kdyz
jsi ve vode...
A priznejme si, kdyz te neco praskne
do hlavy pri plavani...
Ja to schytam nejhur.
Tak prosim, pamatuj na to.
Kvuli me, {Player}!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Don't just wander around aimlessly...
That's the quickest way to get lost!
If you do get lost, look at your {Color:Red}map{Color:White}
immediately to get your bearings.
You will find your way only if you know
where you are AND where you're going.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Nechod' jen tak bezcilne...
To je nejrychlejsi zpusob zabloudeni!
Kdyz zabloudis, hned mrkni na
{Color:Red}mapu{Color:White} pro orientaci.
Cestu najdes jen kdyz vis,
kde jsi A kam jdes.

en:
{Sound:00:92}That phantom we saw earlier... He said
he was {Color:Green}an ancient king of Hyrule{Color:White}.{01:0A}
{01:01}What else do we know? The {Color:Red}element{Color:White} was
nowhere to be seen in the {Color:Green}Wind Ruins{Color:White}.
I guess we'll just have to go to
the place marked on our {Color:Red}map{Color:White}...
But first, you should infuse your
{Color:Red}sword{Color:White} with that {Color:Red}element{Color:White}.
We must head for the {Color:Green}elemental
sanctuary{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Ten prizrak, co jsme videli...
rikal, ze je {Color:Green}stary kral Hyrule{Color:White}.{01:0A}
{01:01}Co jeste vime? {Color:Red}Element{Color:White} nebyl
nikde ve {Color:Green}Vetrnych ruinach{Color:White} videt.
Asi budeme muset jit na misto
oznacene na {Color:Red}mape{Color:White}...
Ale nejdriv nasyt svuj
{Color:Red}mec{Color:White} tim {Color:Red}elementem{Color:White}.
Musime do {Color:Green}elementalni
svatyne{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:00:92}It seems the king and the guards are
not be able to see it...
But the entrance to the {Color:Green}elemental
sanctuary {Color:White}MUST be inside {Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Vypada to, ze kral a strazci
to nevidi...
Ale vchod do {Color:Green}elementalni
svatyne {Color:White}MUSI byt na {Color:Green}hrade Hyrule{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}{Player}! Aren't you forgetting
a little something?
We need to infuse your {Color:Red}sword{Color:White} with the
{Color:Red}element {Color:White}that we worked so hard to get!
After all, we certainly worked hard
enough to get it. We ought to use it!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}{Player}! Nezapominas na
neco?
Musime naplnit tvuj {Color:Red}mec{Color:White}
{Color:Red}elementem{Color:White}, co jsme tezce ziskali!
Urcite jsme na to tvrdle pracovali.
Meli bychom ho pouzit!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}I suppose we'll have to try going
to the point marked on the {Color:Red}map{Color:White}...
We have no other clues leading us to
the remaining {Color:Red}element{Color:White}, that's for sure.
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Asi to musime zkusit s bodem
oznacenym na {Color:Red}mape{Color:White}...
Jine stopy k zbylemu {Color:Red}elementu{Color:White}
nemame, to je jiste.

en:
{Sound:00:92}{Player}, there's only one
{Color:Red}element{Color:White} remaining!
Once you've used the {Color:Red}sacred blade{Color:White} to
free Princess Zelda from her curse,
perhaps you can ask her out on
a date or something.
{Sound:00:8D}Don't worry, I'll be right there with you!
You will need my advice, after all!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}{Player}, zbyva uz jen jeden
{Color:Red}element{Color:White}!
Az posvatnou {Color:Red}cepeli{Color:White} vysvobodis
princeznu Zeldu z jeji kletby,
mozna ji muzes pozvat
na rande.
{Sound:00:8D}Neboj, budu s tebou!
Budes potrebovat mou radu!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Did you see that?
{Color:Green}King Gustaf{Color:White} was calling us...{01:0A}
{01:01}Perhaps we ought to visit the point
marked on our {Color:Red}map{Color:White}.
It may have been a dream, but I'm sure
it will make sense if we go there.
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Videl jsi to?
{Color:Green}Kral Gustaf{Color:White} nas volal...{01:0A}
{01:01}Mozna bychom meli navstivit
bod oznaceny na {Color:Red}mape{Color:White}.
Mozna to byl sen, ale urcite
to bude davat smysl, az tam dojdeme.

en:
{Sound:00:91}Uhh... Don't tell me the new path leads
us {Color:Green}into a grave{Color:White}...?{01:0A}
{01:01}That means {Color:Green}King Gustaf{Color:White} must really
have been a...a...
{Sound:00:90}Whoa! I just got a chill down my seam!

{Sound:00:90}I haven't mentioned it up to now, but
ghosts and stuff like that...{01:0A}
{01:01}{Sound:00:91}They really give me the heebie-jeebies.

So I'd rather not go into that grave if
we can avoid it at all...
But, {Player}, this doesn't seem
to bother you very much...
Either you're very much in control of
your fear...
Or you haven't really registered what's
going on here...
cz:
{Sound:00:90}Doted jsem to nerikal, ale
duchove a takove veci...{01:0A}
{01:01}{Sound:00:91}Fakt me strasne desi.

Tak radeji bych nechodil do toho
hrobu, kdyz to jde...
Ale, {Player}, tebe to zda se
nijak netrapi...
Bud' mas svuj strach fakt pod
kontrolou...
Nebo ti fakt nedoslo, co se
tady deje...

en:
{Sound:00:92}Fine, fine!! {Color:Green}King Gustaf{Color:White} is waiting for
us inside that crypt!
And remember, it IS the Royal Crypt, so
show a little respect in there!
Got that, {Player}?
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Dobre, dobre!! {Color:Green}Kral Gustaf{Color:White} na
nas ceka v te krypte!
A pamatuj, JE to Kralovska krypta,
tak tam projev trochu ucty!
Rozumis, {Player}?

en:
{Sound:00:91}Sooo... Meeting a dead king means...{01:0A}

{01:01}He must have had unfinished business
in the world of the living.
He seemed awfully polite for a ghost.
I expected...spookier, I suppose.
What do you suppose he meant by all
that "{Color:Green}source of the flow{Color:White}" business?{01:0A}
cz:
{Sound:00:91}Takze... Setkat mrtveho krale znamena...{01:0A}

{01:01}Musel mit nedokoncenou vec
ve svete zivych.
Byl na ducha strasne zdvorily.
Cekal jsem...strasidelnejsi.
Co tim myslel s tim
"{Color:Green}zdrojem toku{Color:White}"?{01:0A}

en:
{Sound:00:92}"{Color:Green}The source of the flow{Color:White}"...

In other words, a place that the water
comes from, wouldn't you say?
Now, ask yourself: {Color:Blue}where does all the
water{Color:White} in Hyrule {Color:Blue}come from{Color:White}?
cz:
{Sound:00:92}"{Color:Green}Zdroj toku{Color:White}"...

Jinymi slovy, misto, odkud
tece voda, ze?
Zeptej se sebe: {Color:Blue}odkud tece
vsechna voda{Color:White} v Hyrule {Color:Blue}pochazi{Color:White}?

en:
{Sound:00:92}We only need to find one more {Color:Red}element{Color:White}.

And while we don't know exactly where it
is, we've got a good lead to follow!
I'm sure we'll be on the right track if
we find Gustaf's "{Color:Green}source of the flow{Color:White}"!
{Sound:00:8D}Let's go, {Player}!!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Zbyva najit uz jen jeden {Color:Red}element{Color:White}.

A i kdyz nevime presne, kde je,
mame dobrou stopu!
Urcite budeme na spravne ceste,
kdyz najdeme Gustaftv "{Color:Green}zdroj toku{Color:White}"!
{Sound:00:8D}Jdeme, {Player}!!

en:
{Sound:00:90}Of course! The {Color:Green}source of the flow{Color:White}!
He meant {Color:Green}Veil Springs{Color:White}!
I wonder what lies up ahead...

{Sound:00:8D}Well, we know it's connected to the
{Color:Red}element{Color:White}, so let's go, {Player}!
cz:
{Sound:00:90}Jasne! {Color:Green}Zdroj toku{Color:White}!
Myslel {Color:Green}Veil Springs{Color:White}!
Co tam asi lezi...

{Sound:00:8D}Vime, ze to souvisi s
{Color:Red}elementem{Color:White}, tak jdeme, {Player}!

en:
What's happening to the {Color:Green}source
of the water{Color:White}?
There shouldn't be anything but
blue sky up there!
Well, no point sitting around thinking
about it!
... ...{01:0A}

{01:01}Hey, I just realized something.{01:0A}

{01:01}I'm starting to think...and talk...
a lot like you lately! What's with that?{01:0A}
{01:01}{Sound:00:8D}I need to get my head straight!
cz:
Co se deje s {Color:Green}zdrojem
vody{Color:White}?
Mela by tam byt jenom
modra obloha!
Nema smysl tu sedet a
premyslet o tom!
... ...{01:0A}

{01:01}Hej, prave mi neco doslo.{01:0A}

{01:01}Zacinam premyslet...a mluvit...
dost jako ty! Co je to?{01:0A}
{01:01}{Sound:00:8D}Potrebuji si srovnat hlavu!

en:
{Sound:00:92}There must be {Color:Blue}something{Color:White} just beyond
{Color:Green}Veil Springs{Color:White} that leads to the {Color:Red}element{Color:White}.
We're just one step away from being
able to lift {Color:Green}Princess Zelda{Color:White}'s curse!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Musi tu byt {Color:Blue}neco{Color:White} tesne za
{Color:Green}Veil Springs{Color:White}, co vede k {Color:Red}elementu{Color:White}.
Jsme jen krok od moznosti
sundat kletbu {Color:Green}princezne Zelde{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}A world of clouds high above
the ground...
I feel like I've seen it all now!

{Player}, perhaps it would be
best if you didn't look down.
One false step and...{01:0A}
{01:01}{Sound:00:90}I don't even want to think about it!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Svet mraku vysoko nad
zemi...
Mam pocit, ze jsem videl vse!

{Player}, mozna by bylo
lepsi, kdybys se nedival dolu.
Jeden spatny krok a...{01:0A}
{01:01}{Sound:00:90}Ani na to nechci myslet!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Nothing but clouds, as far as the eye
can see!
But there's got to be a clue to the
final {Color:Red}element{Color:White}'s location somewhere!
Keep those eyes peeled, {Player}!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Samy mraky, kam oko dohledi!

Ale musi tu byt nejaka stopa k
poslednimu {Color:Red}elementu{Color:White}!
Mej oci na strope, {Player}!

en:
{Sound:00:92}That tornado near {Color:Green}Veil Springs {Color:White}took us
to this cloud world! Can you believe it?
I don't know what awaits us next, 
but I can't wait to find out!
... ...{01:0A}
{01:01}Hm? Hey, {Player}!!
{Sound:00:8D}Don't get all scared on me now!
Show me some spirit, lad!
Let's enjoy ourselves!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}To tornado u {Color:Green}Veil Springs {Color:White}nas
dostalo do sveta mraku! Veris tomu?
Nevim, co nas ceka, ale nemuzu
se dockat, az to zjistim!
... ...{01:0A}
{01:01}Hm? Hej, {Player}!!
{Sound:00:8D}Neblazni mi tady ted' strachem!
Ukaz trochu ducha, chlapce!
Uzijme si to!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}The people who live on the clouds must
know something of the last {Color:Red}element{Color:White}!
We should certainly ask, at any rate!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Lide, co ziji na mracich, musi
vedet neco o poslednim {Color:Red}elementu{Color:White}!
Urcite bychom se meli zeptat!

en:
{Sound:00:92}What is it, {Player}?

Weren't we going to ask the wind folk
here about that last element?
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Co je, {Player}?

Nechteli jsme se zeptat lidi
vetru o poslednim elementu?

en:
{Sound:00:8E}We come all this way to the clouds, and
we have ANOTHER building to explore?
And what's holding that thing up
in the first place?
{Sound:00:92}{Player}, walk very carefully up
here, you got that!?
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Prijeli jsme az sem do mraku,
a cekaji DALSI budovy k prozkoumani?
A co vlastne to drzi
nahore?
{Sound:00:92}{Player}, chod' tu hodne
opatrne, rozumis!?

en:
{Sound:00:90}Wow, a {Color:Green}Palace of Winds{Color:White} atop a
field of clouds... How elegant.
But that's not our first concern.
The monsters here are pretty tough.
Watch your footing, and make sure
you don't fall!
cz:
{Sound:00:90}Wau, {Color:Green}Palac vetru{Color:White} na
poli mraku... Jak elegantni.
Ale nas neni starost.
Nestvury tu jsou dost tvrde.
Davej pozor, kam slapes, at
nespadnes!

en:
{Sound:00:92}So the last {Color:Red}element{Color:White} is in the deepest
recesses of the {Color:Green}Palace of Winds{Color:White}...
We've finally done it, {Player}!
{Sound:00:8D}You know what you have to do now!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Takze posledni {Color:Red}element{Color:White} je v
hlubinach {Color:Green}Palace vetru{Color:White}...
Konecne jsme to dokazali, {Player}!
{Sound:00:8D}Vis, co ted' musis udelat!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Whoa!

Maybe fighting the flow isn't what we're
supposed to be doing here...
Perhaps we should just let it carry
us along for a bit.
If you can't beat 'em, join 'em, right?
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Ou!

Mozna neni potreba bojovat proti
proudu...
Mozna se nechame chvili nest.

Kdyz je neporazis, pridej se, ze?

en:
{Sound:00:92}{Player}! I'm overcome!
We've got all the {Color:Red}elements{Color:White} now!
Now we can revive the {Color:Red}sacred blade{Color:White}!

You'll have {Color:Green}Princess Zelda{Color:White} back to
normal in no time!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}{Player}! Jsem u vytrzeni!
Mame vsechny {Color:Red}elementy{Color:White}!
Ted' muzeme obnovit {Color:Red}posvatnou cepel{Color:White}!

Za chvilku bude {Color:Green}princezna Zelda{Color:White}
zpet normalni!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}This will go down in legend!

To think that I will witness the
rebirth of the {Color:Red}sacred blade{Color:White}!
I can barely contain myself! Quickly!
Quickly! To the {Color:Green}elemental sanctuary{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Tohle prejde do legend!

Pomyslet, ze budu svedkem
zrozeni {Color:Red}posvatne cepele{Color:White}!
Sotva se ovladam! Rychle!
Rychle! Do {Color:Green}elementalni svatyne{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}The king and the guards must not be
able to see it...
But the entrance to the {Color:Green}elemental
sanctuary {Color:White}is right in the courtyard!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Kral a strazci to zjevne nevidi...

Ale vchod do {Color:Green}elementalni
svatyne {Color:White}je prime na nadvori!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}How...could he?! {Color:Green}Vaati {Color:White}will pay for this!{01:0A}

{01:01}{Sound:00:92}{Player}! Now is the time to use the
true power of the sacred {Color:Red}Four Sword{Color:White}!!
You can {Color:Blue}lift the curse{Color:White} from each of
these people, one by one!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Jak...to mohl?! {Color:Green}Vaati {Color:White}za to zaplati!{01:0A}

{01:01}{Sound:00:92}{Player}! Ted' je cas pouzit
pravou silu posvatneho {Color:Red}Ctyrmece{Color:White}!!
Muzes {Color:Blue}sundat kletbu{Color:White} z kazdeho
z techto lidi, jednoho po druhem!

en:
{Sound:00:92}{Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White} has fallen into darkness.

This place is a den of evil for {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}
and his beast minions now...
I understand your haste, but it may
be wise to retreat for now...
Just until we've prepared ourselves to
face this challenge anew!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}{Color:Green}Hrad Hyrule{Color:White} padl do temnoty.

Toto misto je ted' doupetem zla
pro {Color:Green}Vaatiho{Color:White} a jeho poskoky...
Chapu tvuj spech, ale mozna
by bylo moudre ted' ustoupit...
Dokud se nepripravime na
novou vyzvu!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}{Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White} has become a castle of
darkness now, and I fear for the {Color:Green}king{Color:White}.
{Player}! You are the only one in all
of Hyrule who can save those people!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}{Color:Green}Hrad Hyrule{Color:White} se stal hradem
temnoty a bojim se o {Color:Green}krale{Color:White}.
{Player}! Jsi jediny v celem
Hyrule, kdo muze ty lidi zachranit!

en:
{Sound:00:92}If Vaati is after the {Color:Red}light force{Color:White}, he
won't stop until he's drained {Color:Green}Zelda{Color:White}!
I doubt she will be able to survive the
extraction process...
{Sound:00:8D}{Player}! We must hurry to the roof
of {Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Kdyz Vaati jde po {Color:Red}sile svetla{Color:White},
nezastavi se, dokud nevysaje {Color:Green}Zeldu{Color:White}!
Pochybuji, ze prezije proces
extrakce...
{Sound:00:8D}{Player}! Musime pospisit
na strechu {Color:Green}hradu Hyrule{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:00:92}We will get through this!

We have all of the techniques and
power you've gained in your journey!
{Sound:00:8D}And we have your wisdom and courage
as well! {Player}! I believe in you!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Zvladneme to!

Mame vsechny techniky a silu,
co jsi ziskal na sve ceste!
{Sound:00:8D}A mame i tvou moudrost a odvahu!
{Player}! Verim ti!

en:
{Sound:00:91}Hyrule Castle has grown dark...
Perhaps this repulsive scene...
is just a reflection of the evil lurking
in the heart of my former student.
... ...{01:0A}
{01:01}Ah, what have I created?
But don't worry about me, {Player}!
{Sound:00:8D}I know what we must do!!
cz:
{Sound:00:91}Hrad Hyrule ztemnel...
Mozna tato ohavna scena...
je jen odrazem zla ukryteho
v srdci meho byvaleho zaka.
... ...{01:0A}
{01:01}Ach, co jsem stvoril?
Ale neboj se o me, {Player}!
{Sound:00:8D}Vim, co musime udelat!!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}We have no time!!
We must get to Princess Zelda!!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Nemame cas!!
Musime se dostat k princezne Zelde!!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}What are you doing talking to me!!
We have no time for this!!
Let's go, {Player}!!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Co delas, ze se mnou mluvis!!
Nemame na to cas!!
Jdeme, {Player}!!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}{Color:Green}Princess Zelda{Color:White}!
{Player} and I are on the way!!
Wait for us! We're coming!!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}{Color:Green}Princezno Zeldo{Color:White}!
{Player} a ja jsme na ceste!!
Cekej na nas! Jdeme!!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Well done, {Player}!
I knew you could do it!!
Now! Let's {Color:Blue}remove that curse{Color:White}
from {Color:Green}Princess Zelda{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Vyborne, {Player}!
Vedel jsem, ze to zvladnes!!
Ted'! Pojd'me {Color:Blue}sundat tu kletbu{Color:White}
z {Color:Green}princezny Zeldy{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Hold on just a little longer, Your
Highness!
Come on, {Player}! Hurry up and
return {Color:Green}Princess Zelda{Color:White} to normal!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Vydrz jeste chvili, Vase
vysosti!
No tak, {Player}! Pospes si a
vrat' {Color:Green}princeznu Zeldu{Color:White} do normalu!

en:
{Sound:00:92}It's been a long road, but we're
almost there. After all...
The sacred {Color:Red}Four Sword{Color:White} that you carry
must be able to remove the curse!
{Color:Green}Princess Zelda{Color:White} will be restored!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Byla to dlouha cesta, ale
jsme skoro tam. Nakonec...
Posvatny {Color:Red}Ctyrmec{Color:White}, ktery nosis,
musi umet sundat kletbu!
{Color:Green}Princezna Zelda{Color:White} bude obnovena!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}It's dangerous here!
{Player}!
Let's get the princess to the
{Color:Green}elemental sanctuary{Color:White} quickly!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Tady je nebezpecno!
{Player}!
Dostanme princeznu do
{Color:Green}elementalni svatyne{Color:White} rychle!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Now that Vaati's power is fading,
this place is crumbling!
{Sound:00:92}{Player}!! {Color:Green}Princess Zelda{Color:White}!!
Watch your footing!!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Ted', kdyz Vaatiho sila slabne,
toto misto se rozpada!
{Sound:00:92}{Player}!! {Color:Green}Princezno Zeldo{Color:White}!!
Davejte pozor na nohy!!

en:
{Sound:00:92}As soon as we take care of one
problem, another one comes up!
{Player}, I'm sorry to have to
say this...
But you'll have to save your joyful
reunion with {Color:Green}Zelda{Color:White} for another time.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Sotva vyresime jeden problem,
objevi se dalsi!
{Player}, je mi lito, ze to
musim rict...
Ale radostne shledani se {Color:Green}Zeldou{Color:White}
si musis nechat na jindy.

en:
{Sound:00:8E}It's nice taking in the view from up
here and all, but...
I'm thinking maybe I should be a
little higher up by now...
What I'm trying to say here, kid, is...
have you been drinking your milk?
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Vyhled odsud je hezky a vse,
ale...
Myslim, ze bych uz mel byt
trochu vyse...
Rikam tim, kluku...
pil jsi vubec mleko?

en:
{Sound:00:8D}Hey, kid! Kid!
Slow down a little!
You seem to have completely forgotten
that I'm on top of your head here!
Man, I hate to think of how this is
going to play out...{01:0A}
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Hej, kluku! Kluku!
Zpomal trochu!
Zda se, ze jsi uplne zapomnel,
ze jsem tu na tve hlave!
Boze, nechci ani premyslet,
jak tohle dopadne...{01:0A}

en:
{01:06}{Sound:00:90}ZZZZZ.......
{01:02}Huh? Whuzza--! What?!
{Sound:00:8D}What are you talking about?!
Me? Sleeping? That's crazy!
{01:06}{Sound:00:90}Mmmmnumumummm...
cz:
{01:06}{Sound:00:90}ZZZZZ.......
{01:02}Ha? Coto--! Co?!
{Sound:00:8D}O cem to mluvis?!
Ja? Spim? To je blaznive!
{01:06}{Sound:00:90}Mmmmmn...

en:
{Sound:00:92}Yes? What's the matter, m'boy?

What? You were just checking up on
me? What's that about!?!
You think I just sit on your head,
waiting at your beck and call?
{Sound:00:8D}I can't believe it! Grumble, grumble...
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Ano? Co je, chlapce?

Co? Jenom me kontrolujes?
Co to ma znamenat!?!
Myslis, ze si jen sedim na tve hlave
a cekam na tve pokyny?
{Sound:00:8D}Nemuzu tomu verit! Bruceni, bruceni...

en:
{Sound:00:8D}Hey, kid! Could you lend me a hand?

{Sound:00:8D}I've got a nasty back itch, and I can't
reach it with my beak.
Could you please scratch me
right there?
No, up! Up! OK, now to the left!
I said left!
... ...{01:0A}
{Sound:00:90}{01:02}{Color:Blue}Ohhh, sweet mercy!{Symbol:0B}{01:03}{01:04}{01:05}{01:04}{01:03}{01:02}{Color:White}
That's the stuff!
{Sound:00:92}{01:01}Thanks, buddy! I owe you one!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Hej, kluku! Podej mi ruku?

{Sound:00:8D}Sve me hnusne zada a nedosahnu
zobakem.
Podrbal bys me
prave tam?
Ne, nahoru! Nahoru! OK, ted' vlevo!
Rikam vlevo!
... ...{01:0A}
{Sound:00:90}{01:02}{Color:Blue}Ach, milosrdenstvi!{Symbol:0B}{01:03}{01:04}{01:05}{01:04}{01:03}{01:02}{Color:White}
To je ono!
{Sound:00:92}{01:01}Diky, kamosi! Dluzim ti!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}Hey! Hey! Stop twirling around like that!
You're giving me the spins, kid!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Hej! Hej! Prestan se tak
tocit! Motas mi hlavu, kluku!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Man, I could really go for a nice,
hot bath right now...
{Sound:00:92}Huh?! What's that?!
{Color:Blue}You'd send me to the cleaners!?{Color:White}
{Sound:00:8D}What makes you think you can treat
me like common laundry, huh?
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Boze, ted' bych ocenil hezkou
teplou koupel...
{Sound:00:92}Co?! Co?!
{Color:Blue}Poslal bys me do cistirny!?{Color:White}
{Sound:00:8D}Co te vede k tomu, ze me
muzes brat jako obycejne pradlo?

en:
Mmmmnumumummm...

Come on, please...
{Color:Blue}Just five more minutes...{Color:White}
{Sound:00:90}I promise I'll get up in five minutes...
cz:
Mmmmmn...

No tak, prosim...
{Color:Blue}Jeste pet minut...{Color:White}
{Sound:00:90}Slibuji, ze vstanu za pet minut...

en:
{Sound:00:90}Mnyawwwn... I don't know why
I'm so tired...
I guess I just get a little bored sitting
up here, watching you wander around.
cz:
{Sound:00:90}Mnaaaa... Nevim, proc
jsem tak unaveny...
Asi se trochu nudim, kdyz tu
sedim a sleduji, jak se poulas.

en:
{Sound:00:8D}Do you have to ask me about every
single little thing?!
Just figure it out for yourself,
you big baby!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Musis se me ptat na kazdou
malou vec?!
Proste na to prijdi sam,
ty velky miminko!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}Oh, NOW you need me?

I was starting to think you'd forgotten
that I was even up here!
...I was starting to get a little lonely.
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Ach, TED' me potrebujes?

Zacinal jsem si myslet, ze jsi
zapomnel, ze jsem tu nahore!
...Zacinal jsem se citit osamele.

en:
{Sound:00:90}Mmmmnumumummm...

{Sound:00:8E}Oh, I couldn't eat another bite...
Let's take the rest home...
Wha--! Oh my! Was I talking in my
sleep or something?
How odd...
{Sound:00:90}Mmmmnumumummm...
cz:
{Sound:00:90}Mmmmmn...

{Sound:00:8E}Ach, nemohu snist ani sousto...
Vezmeme si zbytek domu...
Co--! No teda! Mluvil jsem
ze spanku?
Jak zvlastni...
{Sound:00:90}Mmmmmn...

en:
{Sound:00:92}Ahem! You know, I don't take students
very often or anything...
But for you, I figured I could make an
exception! Just a little one, you know.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Ehm! Vis, ja neberu zaky
casto nebo tak...
Ale u tebe jsem si rekl, ze
udelam vyjimku! Jen malou.

en:
{Sound:00:90}So hungry...

Rrrrrumble rumble...

!!!
{Sound:00:8D}That wasn't my stomach!!
It must have been the wind
or something!
cz:
{Sound:00:90}Takovy hlad...

Rrrrukuruku ...

!!!
{Sound:00:8D}To nebyl muj zaludek!!
Musel to byt vitr nebo
neco takoveho!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}You're so energetic all the time...

Not that I'm saying you're hyperactive
or anything! I meant it as a compliment!
Like...you've got a special talent for
being WAY too peppy or something.
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Jsi porad tak plny energie...

NeriKam, ze jsi hyperaktivni!
Myslim to jako kompliment!
Jako...mas zvlastni talent pro
prilis velky elan nebo tak.

en:
{Sound:00:92}Hmn? Huh?

Strange... I thought a woman was
calling out to me just now...
Maybe it was just my imagination.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Hm? Co?

Divne... Zdalo se mi, ze me prave
volala nejaka zena...
Mozna to byla jen ma fantazie.

en:
{Sound:00:8E}What's up, {Player}?
What can I do for yo--GURRK!
{Sound:01:E4}Owowowow... I jutht bit my thung!
Don't make me thpeak...
{Sound:00:91}Jutht thort it out yourthelf!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Co je, {Player}?
Co pro tebe--GRRK!
{Sound:01:E4}Aujaujau... Kouthl jsem se do jazyka!
Nenutthej me mluvit...
{Sound:00:91}Just to vyresh sam!

en:
You know...{01:0A}

{01:01}{Sound:00:8E}I'm really suffering from lack of
exercise up here...and I had an idea.
{Sound:00:92}{Player}, why don't you climb onto
my head for a while?
cz:
Vis...{01:0A}

{01:01}{Sound:00:8E}Tady nahore fakt trpim nedostatkem
cviceni...a mam napad.
{Sound:00:92}{Player}, nelezl bys chvili
na mou hlavu?

en:
{Sound:00:92}Hey, {Player}, why don't we just take
the rest of the day off?
I'm just beat, I tell you...
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Hej, {Player}, nedali bychom
dnes uz volno?
Jsem uplne vycerpany, rikam ti...

en:
{Sound:00:92}Hm?! Sniff sniff! Sniff sniff!
Do you smell something...weird?
Oh! Oh my! I'm sorry, {Player}!
You see, I... I...
I hid a little eggy snack in your hair
about a month ago, and...
I completely forgot about it!
{Sound:00:91}Oh, dear... It's quite disgusting!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Hm?! Cichcich! Cichcich!
Citis neco...divneho?
Ach! No teda! Promin, {Player}!
Vis, ja... Ja...
Schoval jsem ti do vlasu malou
vajickovou svacinu asi pred mesicem, a...
Uplne jsem na to zapomnel!
{Sound:00:91}Ach, boze... Je to hnusne!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}You know, {Player}, your sword work
really has come a long way.
You remind me of a young me. When I
was your age, I was quite a swordsman!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Vis, {Player}, tvuj boj s mecem
fakt urazil dlouhou cestu.
Pripominas mi meho mladeho ja.
V tvem veku jsem byl skvely sermir!

en:
{Sound:00:92}You know, your hair's always really
messy... A real rat's nest...
As long as I'm up here, no one will ever
need to know. You can thank me later.
But I recommend seeing your stylist
before you next meet {Color:Green}Princess Zelda{Color:White}!
Must look good for the ladies!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Vis, tve vlasy jsou vzdycky
fakt neuprvane... Pravy krysi hnizdo...
Dokud jsem tu, nikdo se to nedozvi.
Muzes mi podekovat pozdeji.
Ale doporucuji navstivit kadernika,
nez zase potkas {Color:Green}princeznu Zeldu{Color:White}!
Musis vypadat dobre pro damy!

en:
{Sound:00:90}Mmmmnumumummm...

Mnn? A test? Oh, no! I forgot to study!

Oh, wow! {Sound:00:8D}What time is it?! And what
was I dreaming about just now?
Maybe I should go back to sleep and
try to figure it out...
{Sound:00:90}Mmmmnumumummm...
cz:
{Sound:00:90}Mmmmmn...

Mn? Test? Ach ne! Zapomnel jsem se ucit!

Ach, wau! {Sound:00:8D}Kolik je hodin?!
